ingredients: raw jackfruit, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander powder, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Boil raw jackfruit until tender. | Heat oil and sautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic. | Add tomatoes and spices and cook well. | Add jackfruit pieces and mix. | Cover and cook until flavours blend. | Serve hot with roti.

ingredients: raw banana, onion, tomato, turmeric, cumin, coriander, oil, salt
method: Boil raw bananas until tender and peel them. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds until they splutter. | Saute onions until golden brown. | Add tomatoes and cook until soft. | Add turmeric and coriander powder and mix well. | Add banana pieces and toss to coat with spices. | Cook for 5 minutes and serve hot.

ingredients: colocasia (arbi), ajwain, turmeric, red chilli powder, amchur, oil, salt
method: Boil arbi until tender and peel. | Heat oil and add ajwain. | Add arbi and fry until crisp. | Add turmeric, red chilli and amchur. | Toss well and serve hot.

ingredients: roasted sweet potato, lemon juice, chaat masala, black salt, cumin powder, coriander, green chilli
method: Roast or boil sweet potatoes until tender. | Peel and cut into bite-sized cubes. | Place in a bowl and sprinkle chaat masala and black salt. | Add cumin powder and squeeze lemon juice. | Toss in chopped coriander and green chilli. | Mix everything well and serve immediately.

ingredients: mixed greens (spinach, bathua, mustard), paneer, onion, ginger, garlic, ghee, garam masala, salt
method: Blanch all greens and blend coarsely. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic in ghee. | Add blended saag and cook. | Add garam masala and simmer. | Add paneer cubes and serve hot.

ingredients: fresh green peas, potato, onion, tomato, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Coarsely grind raw peas. | Heat oil and sautÃ© onion, ginger and chilli. | Add tomato and spices. | Add ground peas and potato. | Add water and cook until thick. | Serve hot with roti.

ingredients: fresh green chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and sautÃ© cumin and onion. | Add ginger, garlic and tomato. | Add spices and green chana. | Add water and cook until tender. | Garnish with coriander and serve.

ingredients: basmati rice, spinach, sweet corn, onion, ginger, cumin, garam masala, ghee, salt
method: SautÃ© onion and ginger in ghee. | Add cumin, spinach puree and corn. | Add soaked rice and spices. | Add water and cook until fluffy. | Serve hot with raita.

ingredients: toor dal, fresh fenugreek leaves, onion, tomato, garlic, turmeric, cumin, ghee, salt
method: Cook toor dal until soft. | Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, garlic and onion. | Add tomato and fenugreek leaves. | Mix into dal and simmer. | Serve hot with rice.

ingredients: drumstick, toor dal, tamarind, tomato, sambar powder, mustard seeds, curry leaves, asafoetida, oil, salt
method: Cook dal and drumstick pieces together. | Add tamarind, tomato and sambar powder. | Simmer until drumstick is tender. | Temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: raw papaya, mustard seeds, green chilli, turmeric, curry leaves, grated coconut, oil, salt
method: Peel and grate or julienne raw papaya. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds until they splutter. | Add curry leaves and dry red chillies. | Add the papaya and mix well. | Add turmeric and salt and stir. | Cook covered on low flame for 10 minutes. | Garnish with coconut and serve.

ingredients: cowpeas (chawli), onion, tomato, garlic, cumin, turmeric, coriander powder, oil, salt
method: Soak and cook cowpeas. | Heat oil and sautÃ© cumin and onion. | Add garlic, tomato and spices. | Add cooked cowpeas and simmer. | Serve hot with bhakri.

ingredients: field beans (val), kokum, coconut, ginger, garlic, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Soak field beans overnight and drain. | Pressure cook until soft. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and saute until golden. | Add tomato and green chillies and cook until soft. | Add the cooked beans and spices. | Simmer for 10 minutes and serve.

ingredients: toor dal, turmeric, jaggery, tamarind, ghee, mustard seeds, asafoetida, salt
method: Sweet, Sour & Mild

ingredients: coriander leaves, besan, sesame seeds, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Make a thick batter with besan and chopped coriander leaves. | Add sesame seeds, green chilli, ginger paste and spices. | Steam the batter in a greased tray for 20 minutes. | Let it cool and cut into rectangles. | Shallow fry the pieces until golden and crispy on both sides. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: moong dal, coconut milk, jaggery, cardamom, cashews, ghee
method: Dry roast moong dal until golden and aromatic. | Pressure cook with milk until soft. | Add sugar and cardamom powder and stir well. | Simmer on low flame until creamy and thickened. | Add saffron soaked in warm milk. | Garnish with cashews and raisins fried in ghee. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: rice ada (flakes), coconut milk, jaggery, cardamom, cashews, raisins, ghee
method: Soak rice ada in water for 30 minutes and drain. | Cook ada in water until soft and set aside. | Heat coconut milk with jaggery until jaggery dissolves. | Add the cooked ada and stir. | Add thick coconut milk and cardamom powder. | Fry cashews and raisins in ghee and add. | Simmer for a few minutes and serve warm.

ingredients: rice ada, milk, sugar, cardamom, rose water
method: Soak rice ada in water for 20 minutes. | Boil milk and add ada, stirring continuously. | Cook on low flame until ada is very soft. | Add sugar and stir until dissolved. | Continue cooking until payasam thickens. | Add cardamom powder and rose water. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: hung curd, mango pulp, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios
method: Hang curd in muslin cloth for 6-8 hours to drain whey. | Mix mango pulp into the hung curd. | Add powdered sugar and cardamom powder. | Whisk until smooth and creamy. | Chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. | Garnish with saffron and pistachio slivers before serving.

ingredients: hung curd, custard apple pulp, sugar, cardamom, saffron, almonds
method: Hang curd overnight in muslin cloth to make chakka. | Scoop out custard apple pulp and remove seeds. | Blend the pulp until smooth. | Mix hung curd with sugar until dissolved. | Add custard apple puree and cardamom powder. | Whisk until creamy and chill before serving.

ingredients: basmati rice, milk, mango pulp, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios
method: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes and grind to a coarse paste. | Boil milk and add the rice paste, stirring continuously. | Cook on low flame until thick, stirring often. | Add sugar and cardamom powder and mix. | Let it cool slightly and add mango puree. | Pour into earthen pots or bowls and chill. | Garnish with pistachio and serve cold.

ingredients: blanched almonds, sugar, milk, ghee, cardamom, saffron
method: Soak almonds overnight and peel them. | Blend to a coarse paste with a little milk. | Heat ghee in a pan and add the almond paste. | Cook on low flame, stirring continuously for 15 minutes. | Add sugar and saffron soaked in milk. | Continue stirring until halwa leaves the sides of the pan. | Garnish with cardamom and serve warm.

ingredients: thin poha, peanuts, curry leaves, green chilli, mustard seeds, turmeric, sugar, oil, salt
method: Sweet, Salty & Crispy

ingredients: cornflakes, peanuts, cashews, curry leaves, mustard seeds, turmeric, sugar, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add peanuts and fry until golden. | Add cashews and raisins and fry briefly. | Add turmeric, red chilli powder and salt. | Add cornflakes and toss quickly to coat. | Mix in sugar and dried coconut. | Cool completely before storing.

ingredients: maida, besan, ajwain, cumin, ghee, salt, water
method: Mix maida and besan with ghee, ajwain and salt. | Add water to make stiff dough. | Roll thin and cut into rounds. | Prick with fork. | Deep fry on low heat until crisp. | Cool and store.

ingredients: potato, besan, black pepper, ajwain, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Boil and grate potatoes. | Mix with besan, spices and salt to form a dough. | Press through a bhujia mould into hot oil. | Fry until golden and crispy. | Drain on paper towels. | Sprinkle chaat masala and toss. | Cool completely before serving.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, jaggery, ghee, cardamom, almonds, raisins
method: Roast wheat flour in ghee until golden and fragrant. | Cool slightly. | Mix with powdered jaggery, cardamom and dry fruits. | Shape into laddus while warm. | Cool completely before storing.

ingredients: dates, figs, mixed dry fruits, cardamom, ghee
method: Blend dates to a sticky paste in a food processor. | Roughly chop all dry fruits including cashews, almonds and walnuts. | Dry roast nuts lightly and let cool. | Mix date paste with all dry fruits. | Add cardamom powder and mix well. | Grease palms and roll into round ladoos. | Refrigerate for an hour before serving.

ingredients: ragi (finger millet) flour, jaggery, ghee, cardamom, coconut, sesame
method: Roast ragi flour in ghee until fragrant. | Mix with powdered jaggery, coconut, sesame and cardamom. | Shape into laddus while warm. | Cool and store.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, ghee, jaggery, cardamom, fennel seeds, almonds
method: Make stiff wheat dough and shape into balls. | Deep fry until golden brown. | Cool and crush coarsely. | Mix with melted jaggery, ghee, cardamom and almonds. | Serve as part of dal baati churma.

ingredients: toor dal, tomato, garlic, lemon juice, pepper, turmeric, oil, salt, coriander
method: Pressure cook dal with tomato and turmeric. | Blend until smooth. | Add lemon juice, pepper and salt. | Temper with oil and garlic. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve hot.

ingredients: yellow moong dal, ginger, garlic, turmeric, lemon juice, cumin, ghee, salt, coriander
method: Cook moong dal until soft. | Blend until smooth. | Add ginger, garlic and turmeric. | Temper with cumin in ghee. | Add lemon juice. | Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

ingredients: tomato, onion, garlic, butter, cream, black pepper, sugar, basil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion and garlic in butter. | Add tomatoes and cook until mushy. | Blend until smooth and strain. | Add sugar, pepper and cream. | Simmer briefly. | Garnish with basil. | Serve hot.

ingredients: spinach, onion, garlic, vegetable stock, cream, black pepper, nutmeg, butter, salt
method: SautÃ© onion and garlic in butter. | Add spinach and cook briefly. | Add stock and blend. | Add cream, pepper and nutmeg. | Simmer briefly. | Serve hot.

ingredients: sweet corn, onion, garlic, butter, milk, pepper, cornflour, spring onion, salt
method: Blend half the corn. | SautÃ© onion and garlic in butter. | Add corn, blended corn and milk. | Thicken with cornflour. | Season with pepper and salt. | Garnish with spring onion.

ingredients: pumpkin, onion, garlic, ginger, coconut milk, cumin, black pepper, butter, salt
method: Roast pumpkin until tender. | SautÃ© onion, garlic and ginger in butter. | Add pumpkin and blend. | Add coconut milk and spices. | Simmer briefly. | Serve hot.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, kidney beans, pasta, tomato, onion, garlic, Italian herbs, pepper, oil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, garlic in oil. | Add vegetables and tomatoes. | Add stock and kidney beans. | Add pasta and herbs. | Simmer until all cooked. | Serve hot.

ingredients: mushrooms, onion, garlic, butter, cream, thyme, pepper, vegetable stock, salt
method: Clean and slice mushrooms. | Heat butter and saute garlic and onion until soft. | Add mushrooms and cook until they release moisture. | Add vegetable stock and bring to a boil. | Simmer for 10 minutes and blend partially. | Add cream, salt and pepper. | Garnish with fresh herbs and serve hot.

ingredients: spinach, green peas, potato, green chilli, ginger, garam masala, cornflour, oil, salt
method: Blanch spinach and squeeze dry. | Mix with mashed peas, potato and spices. | Shape into flat patties. | Shallow fry until golden on both sides. | Serve with mint chutney.

ingredients: hung curd, paneer, onion, green chilli, coriander, cornflour, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Mix hung curd with crumbled paneer and spices. | Add onion, coriander and cornflour. | Shape into patties. | Shallow fry until golden and crisp. | Serve with chutney.

ingredients: soya chaap, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, curd, cream, garam masala, tandoori masala, oil, salt
method: Marinate soya chaap in yogurt and spices for 30 minutes. | Heat oil and fry onions until dark golden. | Blend onions with tomatoes and cashews to a paste. | Cook the paste in oil with whole spices. | Add marinated soya chaap and cook on high flame. | Add water and simmer for 15 minutes. | Finish with cream and kasuri methi.

ingredients: paneer, yogurt, pickling spices, red chilli, mustard oil, kasuri methi, salt
method: Marinate paneer in yogurt, pickling spices and mustard oil. | Leave for 30 minutes. | Grill or bake until charred slightly. | Sprinkle kasuri methi. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: baby potatoes, yogurt, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, oil, salt
method: Boil baby potatoes until just cooked and prick with a fork. | Mix yogurt with tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste and lemon juice. | Coat potatoes well in the marinade and rest for 30 minutes. | Brush with oil and roast in oven at 200C for 20 minutes. | Turn once halfway through cooking. | Finish on high heat for charred edges. | Serve with mint chutney and lemon wedges.

ingredients: broccoli, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli, cumin, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Cut broccoli into large florets and blanch briefly. | Mix thick yogurt with besan, tandoori masala and spices. | Coat broccoli in the marinade and rest for 30 minutes. | Place on a greased baking tray and roast at 200C. | Cook for 20 minutes until edges are charred. | Squeeze lemon juice over and serve immediately. | Garnish with chaat masala and onion rings.

ingredients: paneer bhurji, bread, butter, green chutney, onion, tomato, cheese
method: Prepare paneer bhurji with spices. | Spread green chutney on bread. | Layer paneer bhurji, onion and tomato. | Add cheese slice. | Grill in sandwich maker. | Serve hot.

ingredients: bread, boiled potato, onion, green chilli, coriander, mustard seeds, turmeric, butter, oil, salt
method: Boil and mash potatoes with spices, coriander and green chilli. | Spread the mixture generously on bread slices. | Brush the outside with oil or butter. | Toast on a hot tawa or pan until golden and crispy. | Flip carefully and toast the other side. | Cut diagonally and serve hot. | Accompany with green chutney or ketchup.

ingredients: besan, onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander, turmeric, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Make a thick batter with besan, water and a pinch of baking soda. | Add finely chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander. | Mix in turmeric, red chilli powder and salt. | Heat oil in a pan and pour a ladleful of batter. | Spread into a round shape and cook on medium flame. | Flip and cook the other side until golden. | Serve hot with chutney or ketchup.

ingredients: semolina, yogurt, onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander, oil, salt
method: Mix semolina with yogurt and water to make a thick batter. | Add salt and rest the batter for 30 minutes. | Heat a tawa and grease with oil. | Pour a ladleful of batter and spread gently. | Top with chopped onion, tomato and coriander. | Drizzle oil around edges and cook until golden. | Flip and cook briefly, then serve with chutney.

ingredients: dosa batter, paneer, capsicum, onion, cheese, coriander, spices, oil
method: Spread dosa batter thin on tawa. | Add paneer, capsicum, onion and cheese. | Fold over and cook until crisp. | Slice and serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Maggi noodles, onion, tomato, green chilli, vegetables, butter, coriander, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, green chilli and tomato in butter. | Add vegetables. | Add water and bring to boil. | Add Maggi and masala. | Cook until done. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve hot.

ingredients: bread, sweet corn, onion, green chilli, cheese, butter, black pepper, coriander, salt
method: Mix corn with onion, chilli, cheese and spices. | Spread on bread slices. | Bake or grill until cheese melts and bread is crisp. | Serve hot.

ingredients: wheat flour roti, spiced potato filling, onion, green chutney, tamarind chutney, chaat masala, coriander, salt
method: Prepare spiced potato filling. | Cook thin rotis on tawa. | Brush with oil and place filling. | Add onion, chutneys and chaat masala. | Roll tightly. | Wrap in foil and serve.

ingredients: wheat flour roti, paneer tikka filling, onion, green chutney, tamarind chutney, chaat masala, coriander
method: Marinate and grill paneer. | Cook thin rotis on tawa. | Brush with oil and place paneer. | Add onion, chutneys and chaat masala. | Roll tightly and serve hot.

ingredients: mixed sprouts, tomato, cucumber, onion, lemon juice, chaat masala, coriander, green chilli, salt
method: Steam or use raw sprouts. | Add chopped tomato, cucumber and onion. | Toss with lemon juice and chaat masala. | Add coriander and green chilli. | Serve fresh.

ingredients: cucumber, onion, tomato, coriander, green chilli, lemon juice, roasted cumin, salt
method: Finely dice cucumber, onion and tomato. | Add chopped coriander and green chilli. | Squeeze lemon juice. | Add roasted cumin and salt. | Toss gently. | Serve fresh.

ingredients: macaroni, onion, tomato, capsicum, ginger, garlic, coriander, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Cook macaroni. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic in oil. | Add tomato, capsicum and spices. | Add cooked macaroni and toss. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve hot.

ingredients: white bread, onion, tomato, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, coriander, oil, salt
method: Tear bread into small pieces. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | SautÃ© onion, chilli and tomato. | Add bread pieces and turmeric. | Toss well. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve hot.

ingredients: pasta, tomatoes, onion, garlic, basil, oregano, cheese, olive oil, pepper, salt
method: Boil pasta until al dente, drain and set aside. | Blanch tomatoes, peel and blend to a smooth puree. | Heat olive oil and saute garlic and onion. | Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates. | Add Italian herbs, salt and chilli flakes. | Add vegetables of choice and simmer. | Toss in pasta and serve hot with cheese.

ingredients: pasta, milk, butter, flour, cheese, garlic, mixed herbs, black pepper, salt
method: Cook pasta. | Prepare bÃ©chamel with butter, flour and milk. | Add garlic, herbs and cheese. | Toss pasta in white sauce. | Season and serve hot.

ingredients: burger bun, vegetable patty, cheese, onion, tomato, lettuce, mayo, ketchup, mustard
method: Prepare vegetable and bean patty and pan fry. | Toast burger buns. | Layer lettuce, patty, cheese, onion and tomato. | Add mayo, ketchup and mustard. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: wheat flour tortilla, paneer tikka, onion, capsicum, green chutney, cheese, chaat masala
method: Grill marinated paneer. | Warm tortilla on tawa. | Spread green chutney. | Add paneer, onion and capsicum. | Sprinkle chaat masala and cheese. | Roll tightly and serve.

ingredients: beetroot, potato, green chilli, ginger, cornflour, cumin, coriander, oil, salt
method: Boil and grate beetroot. | Boil and mash potatoes. | Mix beetroot, potato, breadcrumbs and spices. | Add ginger, green chilli and coriander. | Shape into round tikkis. | Shallow fry on a hot tawa with oil until crispy. | Serve with mint chutney.

ingredients: sweet potato, green chilli, ginger, coriander, cornflour, cumin, amchur, oil, salt
method: Boil and mash sweet potatoes. | Add breadcrumbs, cumin powder, chaat masala and salt. | Mix in chopped coriander and green chilli. | Shape into flat round patties. | Shallow fry in oil on a tawa until golden on both sides. | Drain and serve hot. | Accompany with tamarind and mint chutney.

ingredients: banana flower, coconut, onion, mustard seeds, green chilli, turmeric, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Clean banana flower and chop. | Soak in salted water to prevent browning. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add banana flower, onion and spices. | Cook until tender. | Add coconut and serve.

ingredients: tender coconut flesh, coconut water, sugar, cardamom, sago, milk
method: Scoop out tender coconut flesh and chop finely. | Boil coconut milk with sugar until dissolved. | Add cardamom powder and mix. | Add tender coconut pieces and the water. | Simmer for 5 minutes on low flame. | Chill thoroughly in refrigerator. | Serve cold garnished with cashews fried in ghee.

ingredients: raw jackfruit, basmati rice, onion, yogurt, fried onion, saffron, garam masala, ghee, mint, salt
method: Marinate jackfruit in yogurt and spices. | Par cook rice. | Layer jackfruit and rice with saffron, ghee and mint. | Seal and cook on dum for 20 minutes. | Serve with raita.

ingredients: basmati rice, mushrooms, onion, yogurt, saffron, ghee, whole spices, mint, coriander, salt
method: Marinate mushrooms in spiced yogurt. | Par cook rice with whole spices. | Layer mushrooms and rice. | Add saffron, fried onion and ghee. | Cook on dum. | Serve with raita.

ingredients: basmati rice, paneer, yogurt, fried onion, saffron, ghee, garam masala, mint, coriander, salt
method: Marinate paneer in spiced yogurt. | Par cook rice. | Layer paneer and rice. | Add saffron, ghee and fried onion. | Seal and cook on dum. | Serve hot with raita.

ingredients: basmati rice, soya chunks, onion, yogurt, saffron, ghee, whole spices, mint, garam masala, salt
method: Soak soya chunks and squeeze out water. | Marinate in yogurt and biryani spices for 30 minutes. | Parboil basmati rice with whole spices. | Fry onions until golden and caramelized. | Layer rice with soya chunks and fried onions in a pot. | Add saffron milk and seal with dough or foil. | Cook on dum for 20 minutes and serve.

ingredients: basmati rice, chickpeas, onion, tomato, yogurt, saffron, ghee, biryani masala, mint, salt
method: Soak and cook chickpeas until soft. | Parboil basmati rice with whole spices and drain. | Fry sliced onions until deep golden and crispy. | Cook chickpeas in a spiced tomato-onion gravy. | Layer rice and chickpea gravy in a heavy pot. | Top with fried onions and mint leaves. | Seal and cook on dum for 20 minutes.

ingredients: basmati rice, mixed vegetables, onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, whole spices, ghee, salt
method: SautÃ© whole spices, onion, ginger and garlic in ghee. | Add vegetables and rice. | Add water and cook until done. | Fluff and serve with raita.

ingredients: basmati rice, saffron, dry fruits, onion, whole spices, ghee, rose water, milk
method: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes and drain. | Heat ghee and fry whole spices until aromatic. | Add the rice and fry briefly. | Add hot water, saffron milk and salt. | Cook covered until rice is done. | Separately fry cashews, raisins and dry fruits in ghee. | Top the pulao with dry fruits and serve.

ingredients: basmati rice, sugar, saffron, food colour, cardamom, ghee, dry fruits, rose water
method: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes and parboil. | Heat ghee and add whole spices. | Add sugar and cook until it caramelizes lightly. | Add saffron soaked in warm milk. | Add parboiled rice and mix gently. | Cover and cook on low heat until done. | Garnish with fried dry fruits and edible silver foil.

ingredients: bottle gourd, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, almonds, pistachios
method: Grate lauki and squeeze excess water. | Cook in milk on low heat until soft. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Simmer until thick. | Garnish with nuts. | Serve warm.

ingredients: sabudana, rajgira (amaranth) flour, potato, green chilli, ginger, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak sabudana and drain. | Mix with rajgira flour, potato and spices. | Pat thin on greased tawa. | Cook on medium heat until golden on both sides. | Serve with curd.

ingredients: amaranth flour, potato, green chilli, ginger, coriander, oil, salt
method: Boil and mash potato. | Mix with rajgira flour, spices and salt. | Knead into soft dough. | Roll into parathas. | Cook on tawa with oil until golden. | Serve with curd.

ingredients: boiled potato, sabudana, peanuts, green chilli, ginger, lemon juice, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak sabudana and drain. | Mix with potato, crushed peanuts and spices. | Shape into flat patties. | Shallow fry until crisp and golden. | Serve with yogurt and chutney.

ingredients: water chestnuts (singhara), cumin, green chilli, ginger, coriander, oil, salt
method: Peel and boil water chestnuts until tender. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds. | Add ginger and green chilli and saute. | Add boiled chestnuts and mix well. | Add all dry spices and stir to coat. | Add a little water and cook covered. | Garnish with fresh coriander and serve.

ingredients: buckwheat flour, boiled potato, green chilli, rock salt, oil
method: Mix buckwheat flour with mashed potato, green chilli and rock salt. | Knead into smooth dough. | Roll into puris. | Deep fry until puffed and golden. | Serve with aloo sabzi.

ingredients: barnyard millet (samak), potato, green chilli, ginger, cumin, ghee, rock salt
method: Soak samak rice. | Heat ghee and add cumin. | Add ginger, chilli and potato. | Add samak and water. | Cook until soft. | Serve with curd. (Navratri fasting recipe)

ingredients: raw banana, onion, mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilli, coconut, oil, salt
method: Peel and dice raw banana. | Temper mustard seeds in oil. | Add onion and green chilli. | Add banana, turmeric and salt. | Cover and cook. | Add coconut and serve.

ingredients: sweet corn, spinach, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cream, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Blanch and puree spinach. | SautÃ© onion, ginger and garlic. | Add tomatoes and spices. | Add spinach puree and corn. | Stir in cream and simmer. | Serve with roti.

ingredients: bottle gourd, khoya, sugar, ghee, cardamom, saffron, cashews, raisins
method: Peel and grate bottle gourd, squeezing out excess water. | Heat ghee in a heavy pan and add the grated gourd. | Cook on medium flame stirring often until dry. | Add full fat milk and stir continuously. | Cook until milk is absorbed and halwa thickens. | Add sugar and cardamom and mix well. | Garnish with cashews and serve warm.

ingredients: bread, paneer, gulkand (rose jam), cream cheese, pistachios, cardamom
method: Mix paneer with gulkand, rose petals and cardamom. | Spread rose-flavoured butter on bread slices. | Place the paneer gulkand mixture on one slice. | Top with sliced fruits if desired. | Press the sandwich gently. | Toast lightly or serve fresh. | Cut diagonally and serve.

ingredients: sesame seeds, jaggery, sugar, cardamom
method: Dry roast sesame seeds until golden. | Crush coarsely using a mortar and pestle. | Heat jaggery with a little water to make a syrup of one-thread consistency. | Add crushed sesame seeds to the syrup and mix quickly. | Pour into a greased tray and flatten. | Cut into pieces while still warm. | Cool completely before serving.

ingredients: wheat flour, jaggery, ghee, fennel seeds, cardamom, oil
method: Mix wheat flour with melted jaggery, ghee, fennel and cardamom. | Add water to form stiff dough. | Press through mould or shape with hand. | Deep fry until golden and crisp. | Cool and store.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, sattu, ginger, garlic, green chilli, mustard oil, lemon, brinjal, potato, tomato, salt
method: Knead whole wheat flour with oil and spices into stiff dough. | Make stuffing with sattu mixed with spices, raw onion and mustard oil. | Stuff dough balls with sattu filling and seal. | Roast over charcoal or in oven until charred outside. | Dip in ghee generously. | Roast brinjal and tomatoes and mash with spices for chokha. | Serve litti with chokha and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, roasted chana sattu, onion, green chilli, ginger, mustard oil, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Mix sattu with onion, chilli, ginger and mustard oil. | Prepare wheat flour dough. | Stuff with sattu filling. | Roll and cook on tawa with oil. | Serve with pickle and yogurt.

ingredients: roasted chana sattu, lemon juice, black salt, cumin, water, ice
method: Mix sattu in cold water. | Add lemon juice, black salt and cumin. | Stir until smooth. | Serve chilled with ice. | Popular summer cooling drink.

ingredients: flattened rice (chuda), yogurt, banana, sugar, coconut
method: Wash flattened rice and soak briefly. | Drain and mix with yogurt. | Add banana, sugar and coconut. | Mix gently and serve fresh. | Traditional Odia breakfast.

ingredients: mixed vegetables (raw papaya, brinjal, potato), mustard, garlic, green chilli, mustard oil, salt
method: Boil mixed vegetables together. | Mash coarsely. | Add raw mustard paste, garlic, chilli. | Mix with mustard oil. | Season and serve with rice.

ingredients: sun-dried raw mango pieces, turmeric, chilli, garlic, oil, salt
method: Slice raw mango and sun dry with turmeric and salt. | Store dried pieces. | Temper with oil, garlic and chilli. | Cook briefly. | Serve as sour condiment with rice.

ingredients: gobindobhog rice, moong dal, mixed vegetables, ghee, whole spices, turmeric, ginger, salt
method: Roast moong dal lightly. | Heat ghee and add whole spices and ginger. | Add rice, dal and vegetables. | Add water and turmeric. | Cook until soft. | Serve with labra and begun bhaja.

ingredients: condensed milk, yogurt, saffron, cardamom, pistachios
method: Whisk together condensed milk and yogurt until smooth. | Add cardamom powder and a pinch of saffron. | Pour into small cups or ramekins. | Cover tightly with foil. | Steam in a steamer for 15-20 minutes until set. | Cool to room temperature then refrigerate. | Serve chilled garnished with pistachio.

ingredients: chenna, khoya, maida, sugar, cardamom, rose water, oil
method: Make soft chenna by curdling milk and draining whey. | Knead chenna with a little semolina and cardamom until smooth. | Shape into round or oval balls. | Deep fry on low to medium heat until deep brown. | Make sugar syrup and add rose water and saffron. | Soak fried pantua in warm sugar syrup for 30 minutes. | Serve warm in syrup.

ingredients: chenna, maida, sugar, cardamom, saffron, khoya filling, pistachios
method: Make chenna from full fat milk and knead until smooth. | Add a little semolina and cardamom powder. | Shape into cylindrical pieces. | Cook in boiling sugar syrup for 15 minutes. | Remove and let cool completely. | Fill with sweetened khoya and saffron mixture. | Roll in desiccated coconut and serve.

ingredients: chenna, khoya, maida, sugar syrup, cardamom
method: Prepare soft chenna from milk and knead with semolina. | Roll into cylindrical shapes. | Deep fry on very low heat turning constantly until deep brown. | Make thin sugar syrup with cardamom. | Soak fried lyangcha in hot syrup for 20 minutes. | Allow to absorb syrup completely. | Serve warm.

ingredients: potato, brinjal, tomato, panch phoron, turmeric, cumin, mustard oil, green chilli, salt
method: Cut potato and eggplant into pieces and lightly fry. | Heat mustard oil and add panch phoron. | Add tomato and cook until soft. | Add turmeric, cumin powder and chilli. | Add fried vegetables and water. | Simmer for 10 minutes until gravy is light. | Finish with green chilli and serve with rice.

ingredients: maida, urad dal, fennel, ginger, asafoetida, oil, salt
method: Make dough with maida, oil and salt and rest for 30 minutes. | Make filling with cooked urad dal, ginger, cumin and spices. | Divide dough and roll into small circles. | Place filling in center and seal edges tightly. | Roll gently into puri shape. | Deep fry in hot oil until puffed and golden. | Serve with cholar dal or aloor dom.

ingredients: maida, green peas, ginger, green chilli, fennel, asafoetida, sugar, oil, salt
method: Shell fresh green peas and blanch briefly. | Blend peas with ginger, green chilli and spices to a coarse filling. | Make dough with maida and oil and rest. | Stuff dough balls with pea filling and seal. | Roll gently and deep fry until golden and puffed. | Drain on paper towels. | Serve hot with aloo dum.

ingredients: besan, turmeric, fennel seeds, green chilli, ginger, oil, salt
method: Make a smooth batter with besan, water and spices. | Add chopped onion, green chilli and coriander. | Beat until light and fluffy. | Heat oil in a pan to medium heat. | Drop small spoonfuls of batter into oil. | Fry until golden brown on all sides. | Drain and serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: puffed rice, onion, tomato, cucumber, boiled potato, green chilli, mustard oil, lemon, chaat masala, coriander, salt
method: Measure out puffed rice into a large bowl. | Add finely chopped onion, tomato and green chilli. | Add cucumber, boiled potato and mustard oil. | Mix in tamarind water, salt and black salt. | Add bhujia sev and chanachur. | Toss everything together just before serving. | Serve immediately as it gets soggy quickly.

ingredients: flattened chickpeas, onion, green chilli, coriander, lemon, chaat masala, mustard oil, salt
method: Soak dried flat chickpeas overnight and drain. | Pressure cook until just tender but not mushy. | Heat oil and add cumin and dry red chilli. | Add the chickpeas and toss well. | Sprinkle chaat masala, black salt and amchur. | Add finely chopped onion and green chilli. | Toss and serve warm as a snack.

ingredients: rice flour, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, water
method: Make rice flour dough with hot water and knead smooth. | Make filling with grated coconut and jaggery cooked until thick. | Pinch off dough and flatten into circles. | Place coconut filling and fold into half-moon shape. | Press edges to seal firmly. | Steam or deep fry until cooked through. | Serve warm as a sweet snack.

ingredients: maida, semolina, coconut, jaggery, cardamom, milk, oil
method: Make thin crepes from maida, semolina and milk. | Cook coconut and jaggery for filling. | Spread filling on crepe and roll. | Serve warm as winter pitha.

ingredients: boiled potato, white peas, tamarind chutney, green chutney, onion, green chilli, chaat masala, coriander
method: Boil potatoes and chickpeas until tender. | Cube potatoes and mix with chickpeas in a bowl. | Add tamarind water, green chilli and ginger. | Season with black salt, cumin powder and chaat masala. | Mix in chopped coriander and onion. | Toss everything together. | Serve at room temperature as a street food snack.

ingredients: onion rings, potatoes, green chilli, besan batter, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Make a smooth besan batter with spices and water. | Slice vegetables like onion rings, brinjal or cauliflower. | Dip each piece in the batter to coat. | Heat oil to medium-high temperature. | Fry the coated vegetables until crispy and golden. | Drain well on paper towels. | Serve hot with kasundi mustard sauce.

ingredients: chana dal, coconut, raisins, cashews, potato, tomato, panch phoron, ghee, sugar, oil, salt
method: Grind soaked dal and season. | Steam in tray, cool and cut into diamond shapes. | Fry until golden. | Prepare light tomato gravy with panch phoron. | Add fried dhokar pieces. | Simmer and serve.

ingredients: fresh chhena (paneer), sugar, cardamom, semolina, cashews, raisins, ghee
method: Knead chhena with sugar, semolina and cardamom. | Add cashews and raisins. | Pour into greased pan. | Bake until caramelized and golden brown outside. | Cool completely before cutting. | Serve.

ingredients: chenna, sugar, cardamom, rose water, saffron, oil
method: Knead fresh chenna until smooth. | Add semolina and cardamom powder and mix. | Shape into disc-like pieces. | Deep fry on low heat until golden brown. | Prepare thick sugar syrup with cardamom. | Soak fried jhili in hot syrup for 30 minutes. | Serve in syrup garnished with saffron.

ingredients: sabudana (tapioca pearls), peanuts, potato, green chilli, cumin seeds, lemon juice, coriander, ghee, salt
method: Soak sabudana for 4 hours and drain. | Roast peanuts and crush coarsely. | Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and green chilli. | Add boiled potatoes and sabudana. | Add peanuts, salt and lemon juice. | Cook until sabudana turns translucent. | Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

ingredients: flattened rice (poha), onion, potato, mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilli, curry leaves, lemon juice, coriander, oil, salt
method: Rinse poha and drain. | Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion, green chilli and potato and cook. | Add turmeric and poha and mix gently. | Add salt and lemon juice. | Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

ingredients: semolina (rava), yogurt, green chilli, ginger, cashews, mustard seeds, curry leaves, baking soda, oil, salt
method: Roast rava lightly. | Mix with yogurt, green chilli, ginger and salt. | Add baking soda and rest for 30 minutes. | Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and cashews. | Mix into batter and steam in idli molds until cooked. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: urad dal, green chilli, ginger, curry leaves, black pepper, oil, salt
method: Soak urad dal and grind to smooth batter. | Add green chilli, ginger, pepper, curry leaves and salt. | Shape into rings and deep fry until golden. | Serve hot with sambar and chutney.

ingredients: dosa batter, potato, onion, mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Soak rice and urad dal separately and grind to smooth batter. | Ferment batter overnight at room temperature. | Boil and mash potatoes with tempered onion and spices for filling. | Spread thin dosa on hot greased tawa. | Place potato filling in center and fold. | Cook until crispy and golden. | Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

ingredients: semolina, onion, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts, water, oil, salt
method: Roast semolina lightly. | Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves and peanuts. | SautÃ© onion, ginger and green chilli. | Add water and bring to boil. | Add semolina gradually and stir. | Cook until water is absorbed. | Serve hot.

ingredients: rice, moong dal, black pepper, cumin, ginger, ghee, cashews, curry leaves, salt
method: Cook rice and moong dal together until mushy. | Heat ghee and add pepper, cumin, ginger and cashews. | Add curry leaves and temper. | Mix tempering into pongal. | Serve hot with sambar and chutney.

ingredients: dosa batter, onion, carrot, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Use leftover dosa batter or prepare fresh. | Add finely chopped onion, curry leaves and mustard seeds. | Heat appe pan and add a drop of oil in each mould. | Pour batter into each mould until three-quarters full. | Cook covered on medium heat for 3 minutes. | Flip using a skewer and cook other side. | Serve hot with coconut chutney.

ingredients: green moong dal, ginger, green chilli, cumin, onion, oil, salt
method: Soak moong dal and grind with ginger, chilli and cumin. | Spread thin on hot tawa. | Add onion on top and press lightly. | Drizzle oil and cook until crisp. | Serve hot with ginger chutney.

ingredients: dosa batter, onion, tomato, green chilli, carrot, coriander, oil, salt
method: Pour thick batter on hot tawa. | Spread vegetables evenly on top. | Drizzle oil around edges. | Cook until bottom is set, then flip. | Cook other side and serve hot.

ingredients: rice flour, onion, green chilli, grated coconut, coriander leaves, carrot, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour with chopped vegetables, coconut, coriander and salt. | Add water to form soft dough. | Pat onto greased tawa. | Cook on medium heat with oil until golden on both sides. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: jowar flour, bajra flour, besan, rice flour, onion, green chilli, coriander, oil, salt
method: Mix all flours with chopped onion, chilli, coriander and salt. | Add water to form soft dough. | Pat thin on hot tawa. | Make holes and pour oil. | Cook until crisp on both sides. | Serve hot with curd.

ingredients: sprouted moth beans, onion, tomato, coconut, tamarind, kolhapuri masala, pav buns, farsan, oil, salt
method: Cook sprouted moth beans. | Prepare spicy gravy with coconut, tamarind and kolhapuri masala. | Add cooked beans and simmer. | Serve hot topped with farsan and onion with buttered pav.

ingredients: flattened rice, onion, potato, peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, lemon juice, oil, salt
method: Wash poha and drain, sprinkling with a little water to soften. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds until they pop. | Add curry leaves and green chilli. | Add sliced onions and cook until translucent. | Add turmeric and salt and mix. | Add softened poha and toss gently. | Squeeze lemon and garnish with coriander before serving.

ingredients: besan, onion, green chilli, ginger, coriander, turmeric, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Make a smooth batter with besan, water and spices. | Add finely chopped onion, tomato, coriander and green chilli. | Season with cumin, turmeric and salt. | Heat a non-stick tawa and grease lightly. | Pour a ladleful of batter and spread thin. | Drizzle oil around edges and cook until golden. | Flip and cook briefly then serve hot.

ingredients: moong dal, ginger, green chilli, cumin, onion, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak moong dal and grind to batter. | Add ginger, chilli, cumin, onion and coriander. | Spread thin on hot tawa. | Drizzle oil and cook until crisp. | Serve with green chutney.

ingredients: semolina, sugar, ghee, water, cardamom, cashews, raisins
method: Heat ghee and roast semolina until golden and fragrant. | Add hot water carefully. | Add sugar and cook until thick. | Add cardamom, cashews and raisins. | Serve hot.

ingredients: khoya, maida, baking soda, sugar, cardamom, rose water, oil
method: Mix khoya, maida and baking soda into soft dough. | Shape into small balls. | Deep fry on low heat until golden brown. | Soak in cardamom and rose water sugar syrup. | Serve warm.

ingredients: rice, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, cashews, almonds, raisins, rose water
method: Cook rice in milk on low heat stirring frequently. | Add sugar and simmer until thick. | Add cardamom, saffron and rose water. | Garnish with dry fruits. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: full fat milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios, almonds
method: Boil milk in wide pan. | Keep simmering on low heat. | Collect cream forming on sides. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Cook until thick and creamy. | Garnish with nuts and serve.

ingredients: hung curd, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios, almonds
method: Hang curd in muslin cloth overnight. | Mix hung curd with sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Blend until smooth. | Garnish with nuts and serve chilled.

ingredients: wheat flour, chana dal, jaggery, cardamom, turmeric, ghee, oil
method: Cook chana dal until soft and drain excess water. | Mix with jaggery and cook until thick, add cardamom and nutmeg. | Cool the puran filling completely. | Make soft dough with wheat flour and rest. | Stuff generous portions of puran into dough balls. | Roll gently into flat rotis. | Cook on tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.

ingredients: rice flour, coconut, jaggery, cardamom, ghee
method: Mix rice flour with hot water and knead to a smooth dough. | Make filling with fresh coconut and jaggery, cooked until thick. | Add cardamom and nutmeg to filling. | Take small dough portions and flatten into cups. | Fill with coconut mixture and gather edges to form a peak. | Steam modaks for 10-12 minutes. | Serve warm with ghee.

ingredients: full fat milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, almonds, pistachios
method: Boil milk and reduce on low heat. | Stir frequently until thick. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Simmer briefly. | Garnish with chopped nuts. | Serve warm or cold.

ingredients: maida, khoya, sugar, fennel seeds, cardamom, saffron, oil, rose water
method: Make batter with maida, milk, fennel seeds and cardamom. | Add a pinch of baking powder and rest for 30 minutes. | Prepare thin sugar syrup and keep warm. | Fry ladlefuls of batter in ghee until golden on both sides. | Dip hot malpuas in sugar syrup for 2 minutes. | Remove and arrange on a plate. | Serve warm topped with rabri.

ingredients: chenna (fresh paneer), sugar, rose water, cardamom
method: Curdle full fat milk and strain chenna through muslin. | Hang for 30 minutes then knead until smooth and soft. | Make small smooth balls without cracks. | Prepare thin sugar syrup in a wide pan and bring to boil. | Drop chenna balls in boiling syrup and cover. | Cook on medium-high heat for 15 minutes until doubled. | Cool and refrigerate, serve chilled in syrup.

ingredients: chenna, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios
method: Curdle milk and drain chenna thoroughly. | Knead chenna until very smooth and soft. | Cook in a heavy pan on low flame with sugar, stirring constantly. | Add cardamom powder and cook until it leaves sides of pan. | Shape into desired forms using moulds or by hand. | Decorate with pistachio slivers and saffron. | Chill before serving.

ingredients: full fat milk, yogurt culture, jaggery or sugar
method: Boil full fat milk and reduce to three-quarters quantity. | Add sugar and stir until dissolved. | Add date palm jaggery for flavour and colour. | Cool mixture to lukewarm temperature. | Mix in yogurt culture and stir well. | Pour into earthen pots and cover. | Set in a warm place overnight and refrigerate to serve.

ingredients: vermicelli, milk, sugar, cardamom, cashews, raisins, ghee, saffron
method: Roast vermicelli in ghee. | Add milk and cook until soft. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Fry cashews and raisins in ghee and add. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: semolina, sugar, ghee, water, saffron, cardamom, cashews, raisins
method: Heat ghee and roast semolina. | Add hot water and saffron and cook. | Add sugar and stir until thick. | Add cardamom, cashews and raisins. | Serve warm.

ingredients: moong dal, ghee, sugar, milk, cardamom, saffron, cashews, almonds
method: Soak and grind moong dal. | Roast in ghee until golden and fragrant. | Add milk gradually and cook. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Garnish with nuts. | Serve warm.

ingredients: besan, ghee, sugar, cardamom, cashews
method: Dry roast besan in ghee on low flame, stirring continuously. | Cook until it turns golden and aromatic, about 20 minutes. | Remove from heat and add powdered sugar when slightly cooled. | Add cardamom powder and chopped cashews. | Mix well and while still slightly warm, form into round balls. | Press firmly so they hold shape. | Cool completely before storing.

ingredients: desiccated coconut, condensed milk, cardamom, pistachios
method: Dry roast desiccated coconut lightly until fragrant. | Mix with condensed milk in a pan on low heat. | Stir continuously until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan. | Add cardamom powder and mix well. | Cool slightly until manageable. | Grease palms with ghee and roll into smooth balls. | Roll in fresh coconut and refrigerate.

ingredients: besan, sugar, cardamom, saffron, ghee, pistachios
method: Make thin batter with besan and water, adding food colour. | Press batter through a perforated ladle into hot oil to make tiny boondi. | Fry until just cooked but not crispy. | Drain and add to warm sugar syrup with cardamom. | Let soak until soft then crush gently. | Add melon seeds and mix. | Shape into round ladoos while mixture is warm.

ingredients: sesame seeds, jaggery, peanuts, cardamom, ghee
method: Roast sesame seeds and peanuts. | Melt jaggery and cook until sticky. | Remove from heat and add sesame, peanuts and cardamom. | Quickly shape into laddus before cooling. | Store at room temperature.

ingredients: wheat flour, jaggery, ghee, cardamom, almonds, raisins
method: Prepare stiff wheat dough. | Shape into baatis and bake or fry until golden. | Crush baatis to coarse crumbs. | Mix with melted jaggery, ghee, cardamom and dry fruits. | Shape into laddus and cool.

ingredients: khoya (mawa), sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios
method: Boil full fat milk and simmer on low flame stirring continuously. | Add khoya and continue stirring until very thick. | Add sugar and cook until mixture forms a soft dough consistency. | Flavor with cardamom powder and saffron. | Remove from heat and cool slightly. | Shape into flat round discs. | Press a pistachio on top of each peda.

ingredients: khoya, sugar, cardamom, food colour, silver leaf, pistachios
method: Grate or crumble khoya and cook in a pan on low flame. | Add sugar and stir continuously until sugar melts. | Cook until mixture thickens and leaves sides of pan. | Add cardamom powder and mix. | Pour into a greased tray and spread evenly. | Decorate with silver foil and pistachio. | Cool completely and cut into diamond shapes.

ingredients: desiccated coconut, condensed milk, cardamom, ghee, food colour
method: Mix desiccated coconut with condensed milk in a pan. | Cook on low flame stirring constantly. | Add cardamom powder and rose water. | Cook until mixture is thick and leaves the pan. | Pour into a greased tray and spread evenly. | Let cool at room temperature until set. | Cut into squares and garnish with pistachio.

ingredients: cashews, sugar, water, cardamom, silver leaf
method: Grind cashews to fine powder. | Make sugar syrup to one-string consistency. | Add cashew powder and mix. | Cook until thick. | Spread thin on greased surface. | Cool, apply silver leaf and cut into diamonds.

ingredients: wheat flour, sooji, sugar, ghee, cardamom, puri oil
method: Prepare sooji halwa with ghee, sugar and cardamom. | Knead wheat flour into stiff dough. | Roll small circles and deep fry until puffed. | Serve hot puri with warm halwa and chana.

ingredients: wheat flour, oil, potato, cumin, fennel, turmeric, garam masala, salt
method: Boil and grate potatoes. | Mix with wheat flour, spices, carom seeds and salt. | Knead into a stiff dough without adding water. | Rest the dough for 20 minutes. | Divide and roll into small puris. | Deep fry in hot oil until puffed and golden. | Serve hot with pickle and yogurt.

ingredients: maida, yogurt, baking powder, oil, salt, sugar
method: Mix maida with yogurt, baking powder, sugar and salt. | Knead into soft dough. | Rest for 2 hours. | Roll into oval shapes. | Deep fry until puffed and golden. | Serve hot with chole.

ingredients: maida, oil, salt
method: Mix maida with salt and a little oil. | Knead to a smooth and pliable dough using warm water. | Rest the dough covered for 30 minutes. | Divide into small balls and roll into thin circles. | Deep fry in hot oil until they puff up. | Turn once and fry until pale golden. | Serve immediately with cholar dal or aloo dum.

ingredients: wheat flour, urad dal, fennel seeds, cumin, asafoetida, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Make dough with wheat flour and rest for 30 minutes. | Prepare filling with coarsely ground urad dal, fennel and spices. | Stuff dough balls with filling and seal. | Roll gently into small puris. | Deep fry in hot oil until puffed and golden. | Drain well and serve hot. | Accompany with aloo sabzi and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, spinach puree, ginger, green chilli, carom seeds, oil, salt
method: Blanch and puree spinach. | Mix with flour, ginger, chilli and ajwain. | Knead into smooth dough. | Roll into parathas and cook on tawa with oil. | Serve hot with curd and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, potato, green chilli, ginger, coriander, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Prepare spiced mashed potato filling. | Knead wheat flour dough. | Stuff dough with filling and roll. | Cook on tawa with oil until golden on both sides. | Serve with butter, curd and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, cauliflower, ginger, green chilli, coriander, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Grate cauliflower and mix with ginger, chilli, coriander and salt. | Knead wheat flour dough. | Stuff with cauliflower mixture and roll. | Cook on tawa with oil until golden. | Serve with butter and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, paneer, green chilli, ginger, coriander, cumin, oil, salt
method: Grate paneer and mix with spices, green chilli and coriander. | Make smooth wheat dough and rest for 30 minutes. | Roll a portion of dough into a small disc. | Place paneer filling and seal edges. | Roll gently into a flat paratha. | Cook on hot tawa with ghee until golden spots appear. | Serve with yogurt and pickle.

ingredients: wheat flour, fresh fenugreek leaves, ginger, green chilli, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Mix finely chopped methi with flour, ginger, chilli and ajwain. | Add water and knead into dough. | Roll into parathas and cook on tawa. | Apply oil and cook until golden on both sides. | Serve with curd.

ingredients: wheat flour, white radish, green chilli, ginger, ajwain, coriander, oil, salt
method: Grate radish and squeeze out excess water. | Mix with spices, green chilli and coriander. | Make soft wheat dough and rest for 20 minutes. | Roll dough into circles and place filling. | Seal and roll gently into parathas. | Cook on tawa with generous ghee until golden. | Serve hot with butter and yogurt.

ingredients: wheat flour, cooked chana dal, ginger, green chilli, cumin, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak and cook chana dal until soft then drain. | Mash and season with spices, cumin and dry mango powder. | Make wheat dough and rest for 30 minutes. | Stuff dough balls with spiced dal filling. | Roll into flat parathas. | Cook on tawa with ghee until golden and cooked through. | Serve with raita and pickle.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, mathania red chillies, yogurt, onion, garlic, oil, salt
method: Soak dried red Mathania chillies and grind to a paste. | Heat oil and fry whole spices. | Add onions and cook until dark brown. | Add ginger-garlic paste and red chilli paste. | Cook until oil separates. | Add mixed vegetables and coat well with masala. | Add water and simmer until vegetables are tender.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, semolina, ghee, carom seeds, baking soda, salt
method: Mix flour, rava, ghee, ajwain and salt. | Add water to make stiff dough. | Shape into round balls. | Bake in oven or over fire until golden. | Dip in melted ghee and serve with dal.

ingredients: bajra (pearl millet) flour, water, salt, ghee
method: Mix bajra flour with salt and warm water. | Knead into a stiff dough and divide into portions. | Pat each portion into a flat roti using wet hands. | Place on a hot dry tawa and cook on one side. | Flip and cook the other side pressing gently. | Apply ghee generously and serve hot. | Serve with sarson ka saag or any dal.

ingredients: maize flour (makki), salt, water, ghee
method: Mix maize flour with salt and knead with warm water. | The dough will be slightly rough in texture. | Take a portion and pat into a flat roti with hands or between plastic sheets. | Place on hot tawa and cook on medium flame. | Flip carefully and cook other side. | Apply butter generously. | Serve hot with sarson ka saag.

ingredients: mustard greens, spinach, bathua, ginger, garlic, green chilli, makki flour, ghee, salt
method: Cook mustard greens with spinach and bathua. | Blend coarsely. | SautÃ© ginger, garlic and chilli in ghee. | Add blended greens and makki flour. | Simmer on low heat. | Serve with makki di roti and white butter.

ingredients: okra, buttermilk, besan, turmeric, red chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Slice okra and shallow fry until crispy and set aside. | Make kadhi batter with besan and yogurt. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds, curry leaves and dry red chilli. | Add besan-yogurt mixture and cook stirring continuously. | Add water to adjust consistency and bring to a gentle boil. | Add fried okra and simmer for 5 minutes. | Serve hot with rice.

ingredients: yam (suran), onion, tomato, turmeric, coriander powder, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Peel yam wearing gloves and cut into cubes. | Boil in salted water with tamarind until tender. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add tomato and spices and cook well. | Add boiled yam and mix. | Cook for 5 more minutes and serve.

ingredients: raw banana, black chickpeas, grated coconut, cumin, pepper, red chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook raw banana and chickpeas. | Grind coconut with cumin, pepper and chilli. | Mix into cooked vegetables. | Temper with oil and curry leaves. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: green beans, grated coconut, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Chop beans finely. | Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add beans, turmeric, chilli and salt. | Cover and cook on low heat. | Add coconut and mix. | Serve warm.

ingredients: ash gourd, cowpeas, coconut milk, coconut oil, curry leaves, green chilli, salt
method: Cook ash gourd and cowpeas until tender. | Add coconut milk and simmer. | Add curry leaves, green chilli and coconut oil. | Cook briefly and serve warm.

ingredients: pumpkin, black-eyed peas, grated coconut, cumin, turmeric, red chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Boil pumpkin or raw plantain until tender. | Make a paste of coconut, cumin and garlic. | Add coconut paste to cooked vegetables. | Season with salt and turmeric. | Prepare tempering with coconut oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add dried red chilli and grated coconut and fry until brown. | Pour tempering over curry and mix.

ingredients: ripe mango, yogurt, grated coconut, cumin, turmeric, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Blend coconut, cumin, green chilli and turmeric to a smooth paste. | Mix coconut paste with yogurt. | Add pieces of ripe mango or vegetables. | Cook on low flame stirring gently without boiling. | Season with salt. | Prepare tempering with coconut oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves and red chilli. | Pour tempering and serve immediately.

ingredients: toor dal, mixed vegetables, tamarind, sambar powder, tomatoes, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook toor dal until soft. | Add vegetables, tamarind and sambar powder. | Simmer until vegetables are cooked. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix and serve hot with rice.

ingredients: toor dal water, tomato, tamarind, rasam powder, pepper, cumin, garlic, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Boil tamarind with tomatoes. | Add rasam powder, pepper, cumin and garlic. | Add dal water and simmer. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Garnish with coriander and serve.

ingredients: raw plantain, chana dal, grated coconut, cumin, black pepper, turmeric, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook plantain and dal together. | Grind coconut, cumin and pepper. | Mix paste into cooked vegetables. | Simmer briefly. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: yogurt, grated coconut, cumin, green chilli, turmeric, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Grind coconut with cumin, chilli and ginger. | Mix with yogurt and turmeric. | Heat and stir until warm. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add to yogurt mixture. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: sundakkai (turkey berry), tamarind, sambar powder, sesame oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, fenugreek, salt
method: Extract tamarind water. | Heat sesame oil and temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and fenugreek. | Add sundakkai and fry. | Add tamarind water and sambar powder. | Simmer until thick and oil floats. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: cooked rice, yogurt, milk, mustard seeds, green chilli, ginger, curry leaves, pomegranate, oil, salt
method: Mix cooked rice with yogurt and milk. | Temper mustard seeds, chilli, ginger and curry leaves. | Mix tempering into curd rice. | Add pomegranate and serve at room temperature.

ingredients: cooked rice, lemon juice, peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, curry leaves, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil. | Add peanuts and fry. | Add turmeric, green chilli and cooked rice. | Add lemon juice and mix well. | Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients: cooked rice, tamarind paste, peanuts, mustard seeds, chana dal, urad dal, dry red chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook rice and spread to cool. | Extract thick tamarind juice and cook with spices, peanuts and lentils. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves and dry red chilli. | Add the tamarind mixture to tempering and cook until thick. | Mix the tamarind paste with rice gradually. | Add sesame seeds and adjust salt. | Serve at room temperature.

ingredients: cooked rice, grated coconut, mustard seeds, curry leaves, cashews, dry red chilli, oil, salt
method: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, cashews and red chilli. | Add grated coconut and fry lightly. | Mix into cooked rice. | Season with salt. | Serve warm with papad.

ingredients: cooked rice, tomato, onion, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, coriander, oil, salt
method: Cook rice and keep aside. | Blanch tomatoes, peel and make puree. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds, curry leaves and chana dal. | Add onion and saute well. | Add tomato puree and spices and cook until thick. | Mix the tomato masala with rice. | Serve with papad and raita.

ingredients: brinjal, rice, vangi bath powder, tamarind, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Roast and grind fresh vangi bath masala with spices and coconut. | Cook rice and keep aside. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add small brinjal cut into quarters. | Cook brinjal until tender. | Add vangi bath powder and mix. | Combine with rice and serve hot.

ingredients: rice, toor dal, mixed vegetables, bisibele bath powder, tamarind, ghee, cashews, curry leaves, salt
method: Pressure cook rice and toor dal together until very soft. | Soak and boil mixed vegetables separately. | Prepare bisibele bath masala by dry roasting and grinding spices. | Combine cooked rice, dal and vegetables in a pot. | Add tamarind water and bisibele bath masala. | Simmer until everything blends well. | Add a generous tempering of ghee, mustard and cashews.

ingredients: basmati rice, mixed vegetables, onion, cumin, bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, ghee, salt
method: Heat ghee and sautÃ© whole spices and onion. | Add vegetables and rice. | Add water, salt and cook. | Cover and simmer until rice is cooked. | Fluff with fork and serve hot.

ingredients: basmati rice, cumin seeds, ghee, salt
method: Wash and soak basmati rice for 20 minutes. | Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds. | Let cumin splutter and turn aromatic. | Add drained rice and fry for 2 minutes. | Add hot water in 1:2 ratio and salt. | Cook covered on low flame until done. | Fluff with fork and serve garnished with coriander.

ingredients: basmati rice, green peas, onion, cumin, bay leaf, ghee, salt
method: Wash and soak basmati rice for 20 minutes. | Heat ghee and add whole spices. | Add onion and saute until translucent. | Add fresh or frozen peas and stir. | Add drained rice and mix well. | Add hot water and salt, cover and cook until done. | Fluff gently and serve with raita.

ingredients: basmati rice, mushrooms, onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, garam masala, ghee, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, ginger and garlic in ghee. | Add mushrooms and spices and cook. | Add soaked rice and water. | Cover and cook until rice is done. | Fluff and serve hot.

ingredients: cooked rice, capsicum, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and sautÃ©. | Add capsicum, turmeric and salt. | Cook briefly. | Add cooked rice and toss well. | Serve warm.

ingredients: toor dal, spinach, onion, tomato, garlic, cumin, turmeric, ghee, salt
method: Pressure cook toor dal until soft. | Blanch spinach and roughly chop. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds. | Add onion, garlic and tomato and cook well. | Add all spices and cook until oil separates. | Add cooked dal and spinach and mix. | Simmer for 5 minutes and serve with rice.

ingredients: yellow moong dal, onion, tomato, garlic, cumin, turmeric, ghee, coriander, salt
method: Cook moong dal until soft. | Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, garlic and onion. | Add tomatoes and spices. | Pour over dal and simmer. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve hot.

ingredients: toor (arhar) dal, tomato, onion, garlic, turmeric, cumin, ghee, coriander, salt
method: Pressure cook dal with turmeric. | Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin and garlic. | Add onion and tomato and cook. | Mix tadka into dal. | Simmer briefly. | Garnish and serve.

ingredients: whole urad dal, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, turmeric, ghee, salt
method: Soak urad dal and pressure cook. | Prepare tadka with ghee and spices. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic and tomato. | Mix with dal and simmer. | Serve hot with rice or roti.

ingredients: chana dal, onion, tomato, garlic, cumin, turmeric, coriander, ghee, salt
method: Soak and cook chana dal until soft. | Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin and garlic. | Add onion, tomato and spices. | Mix into dal and simmer. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: toor dal, mixed vegetables, tamarind, sambar powder, mustard seeds, curry leaves, tomato, oil, salt
method: Cook dal until soft. | Add tamarind water, vegetables and sambar powder. | Simmer until vegetables are tender. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix and serve with rice.

ingredients: toor dal, jaggery, tamarind, kokum, tomato, peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook dal with tomatoes. | Add jaggery, tamarind and kokum. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds, curry leaves and peanuts. | Mix into dal. | Simmer and adjust balance of sweet, sour and salt. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: toor dal, turmeric, ghee, mustard seeds, cumin, asafoetida, salt
method: Pressure cook dal with turmeric. | Mash until smooth. | Temper mustard seeds, cumin and asafoetida in ghee. | Mix into dal. | Adjust consistency with water. | Serve over rice with ghee.

ingredients: toor dal, ghee, cumin, mustard seeds, asafoetida, turmeric, red chilli, amchur, salt
method: Cook toor dal until soft. | Heat ghee and add cumin, mustard seeds and asafoetida. | Add turmeric, chilli and amchur. | Mix tadka into dal. | Serve with baati or roti.

ingredients: mixed lentils (toor, masoor, moong), pumpkin, fenugreek, dhansak masala, tamarind, onion, ginger, garlic, oil, salt
method: Cook mixed dals with pumpkin and fenugreek. | Blend coarsely. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic with dhansak masala. | Add dal and tamarind. | Simmer until thick. | Serve with brown rice.

ingredients: paneer, tomato puree, cream, butter, onion paste, ginger-garlic paste, cashews, garam masala, kasuri methi, salt
method: Marinate paneer in spiced yogurt and grill or pan fry. | Blend tomatoes, cashews and onion to a smooth paste. | Heat butter and add whole spices. | Add the tomato paste and cook until oil separates. | Add cream, honey and kasuri methi. | Add grilled paneer and simmer for 5 minutes. | Serve garnished with cream and coriander.

ingredients: paneer, cashews, onion, tomato, cream, cardamom, saffron, ghee, garam masala, salt
method: Blend cashews, onion and tomato into smooth paste. | Fry paste in ghee until oil separates. | Add spices and cream. | Add paneer cubes and saffron. | Simmer briefly. | Serve hot.

ingredients: paneer, onion paste, tomato puree, cashews, cream, whole spices, oil, salt
method: Cut paneer into triangles and stuff with dry fruit filling. | Dip stuffed paneer in batter and shallow fry until golden. | Make rich gravy with onion, cashew and melon seed paste. | Add whole spices, ginger-garlic paste and tomato puree. | Cook until oil separates then add cream. | Slide in fried stuffed paneer pieces. | Simmer briefly and garnish with saffron.

ingredients: paneer, mustard seeds, fennel, nigella seeds, fenugreek, onion, tomato, yogurt, oil, salt
method: Grind pickling spices like fennel, nigella, mustard and fenugreek coarsely. | Heat mustard oil and add the achari spices. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add tomato puree and cook until thick. | Add yogurt and cook stirring well. | Add cubed paneer and toss gently. | Finish with dried mango powder and fresh coriander.

ingredients: paneer, potato, cornflour, onion, tomato, cream, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Grate paneer and mix with mashed potato, cornflour and spices. | Shape into round balls and deep fry until golden. | Blend onion, tomato and cashews to a smooth paste. | Heat oil and add whole spices. | Cook the blended paste until oil separates. | Add cream, kasuri methi and salt. | Add koftas just before serving and simmer briefly.

ingredients: paneer, capsicum, onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, salt
method: Cut paneer and vegetables into strips. | SautÃ© onion, ginger and green chilli. | Add tomato, capsicum and paneer. | Add vinegar and soy sauce. | Toss on high heat. | Serve hot.

ingredients: mixed greens (sarson, spinach), paneer, onion, garlic, green chilli, butter, garam masala, salt
method: Blanch and blend greens coarsely. | SautÃ© onion, garlic and chilli in butter. | Add blended saag and spices. | Add paneer cubes and simmer. | Serve hot with roti.

ingredients: paneer, onion, cashews, yogurt, cream, cardamom, cloves, saffron, oil, salt
method: Blend cashews and onion to paste. | Fry in oil until fragrant. | Add yogurt, cream and spices. | Add paneer cubes and saffron. | Simmer on low heat. | Serve with naan.

ingredients: paneer, capsicum, onion, cornflour, soy sauce, green chilli, garlic, vinegar, tomato ketchup, oil, salt
method: Coat paneer in cornflour and fry. | SautÃ© garlic, green chilli and onion. | Add capsicum and sauces. | Add fried paneer and toss. | Garnish with spring onion. | Serve hot.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, cornflour, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, green chilli, spring onion, oil, salt
method: Shred vegetables, mix with flour and form balls. | Deep fry until golden. | SautÃ© garlic, ginger and green chilli. | Add soy sauce and water for gravy. | Add balls and toss. | Garnish with spring onion.

ingredients: sweet corn kernels, cornflour, rice flour, chilli powder, pepper, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Boil corn kernels. | Mix cornflour, rice flour and spices. | Coat corn and deep fry until crispy. | Toss with chaat masala. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: boiled potatoes, tamarind chutney, green chutney, yogurt, chaat masala, cumin powder, red chilli powder, onion, coriander
method: Fry potato cubes until crisp. | Layer with yogurt, chutneys and spices. | Add chopped onion and coriander. | Sprinkle chaat masala. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: semolina puris, spiced water (pani), boiled potato, moong sprouts, tamarind chutney, chaat masala, coriander, mint
method: Make dough with semolina and knead stiff, rest for 30 minutes. | Roll very thin and cut small circles. | Deep fry on medium heat until puffed and crispy. | Prepare spiced pani with mint, coriander, tamarind and chillies. | Make filling with boiled mashed potato, chickpeas and spices. | Make a hole in each puri and fill with potato. | Dip in pani and eat immediately.

ingredients: puffed rice, sev, onion, tomato, boiled potato, tamarind chutney, green chutney, chaat masala, coriander
method: Mix puffed rice with sev, onion, tomato and potato. | Add both chutneys and toss. | Sprinkle chaat masala. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve immediately while crispy.

ingredients: flat puris, sev, boiled potato, onion, tomato, tamarind chutney, green chutney, chaat masala, coriander
method: Arrange puris on plate. | Top with potato, onion and tomato. | Drizzle both chutneys. | Top generously with sev. | Sprinkle chaat masala and coriander. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: papdi, boiled potato, moong sprouts, yogurt, tamarind chutney, green chutney, sev, chaat masala, coriander
method: Arrange papdis on plate. | Top with potato and sprouts. | Pour yogurt generously. | Drizzle both chutneys. | Add sev, chaat masala and coriander. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: white peas (ragda), boiled potato patties, onion, tomato, green chutney, tamarind chutney, sev, chaat masala, coriander
method: Prepare spiced ragda with white peas. | Shallow fry potato patties until golden. | Serve patties topped with ragda. | Add chutneys, onion and sev. | Sprinkle chaat masala and coriander.

ingredients: potato, besan, mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilli, ginger, coriander, oil, salt
method: Boil and mash potatoes with mustard seeds tempering and spices. | Add curry leaves, green chilli and coriander to filling. | Shape into round balls. | Make thick besan batter with turmeric and salt. | Dip potato balls in batter and coat well. | Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. | Serve hot with green chutney and tamarind chutney.

ingredients: potato, besan, mustard seeds, green chilli, ginger, pav buns, dry garlic chutney, tamarind chutney, oil, salt
method: Prepare batata vada as above and fry until golden. | Slit pav buns without cutting through completely. | Spread dry garlic chutney on one side. | Add green chutney on the other side. | Place hot vada inside the pav. | Serve immediately with fried green chilli. | Add tamarind chutney if desired.

ingredients: sabudana, boiled potato, peanuts, green chilli, ginger, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak sabudana and drain. | Mix with mashed potato, crushed peanuts and spices. | Shape into patties. | Shallow fry until golden and crisp. | Serve hot with yogurt.

ingredients: chana dal, onion, red chilli, green chilli, curry leaves, fennel seeds, ginger, oil, salt
method: Soak chana dal partially and grind coarsely. | Mix with onion, chilies, curry leaves and fennel. | Shape into flat discs. | Deep fry until crispy and golden. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: boiled potato, onion, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, turmeric, besan batter, oil, salt
method: Boil and mash potatoes with turmeric and mustard seeds tempering. | Add curry leaves, green chilli and coriander and mix well. | Shape into round balls. | Prepare thick besan batter with spices. | Dip potato balls in batter and coat completely. | Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. | Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney.

ingredients: leftover dosa/idli batter, onion, green chilli, ginger, cumin, coriander, oil
method: Mix batter with chopped onion, chilli, ginger and cumin. | Drop small amounts in hot oil. | Deep fry until golden and crisp. | Drain and serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: besan, onion, potato, green chilli, ajwain, turmeric, red chilli powder, oil, salt
method: Make thick besan batter with spices, green chilli and coriander. | Add a pinch of baking soda for extra crispiness. | Cut vegetables of choice into desired shapes. | Dip in batter ensuring full coating. | Deep fry in hot oil on medium heat. | Fry until golden and crispy on all sides. | Drain and serve immediately with chutney.

ingredients: spinach leaves, besan, ajwain, red chilli powder, turmeric, rice flour, oil, salt
method: Wash large spinach leaves and pat dry. | Make thick besan batter with spices and green chilli. | Add ajwain and a pinch of baking soda to batter. | Dip each spinach leaf individually in batter. | Deep fry in hot oil until crispy and golden. | Drain well on paper towels. | Serve hot with mint chutney.

ingredients: paneer, besan, ajwain, red chilli powder, chaat masala, coriander, oil, salt
method: Cut paneer into cubes or rectangles. | Make thick besan batter with spices, chilli powder and carom seeds. | Dip paneer pieces in batter to coat. | Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. | Drain on paper towels. | Sprinkle chaat masala and serve hot. | Serve with mint and tamarind chutneys.

ingredients: sweet corn, onion, tomato, cucumber, green chutney, tamarind chutney, sev, lemon, chaat masala, coriander
method: Boil corn kernels. | Mix with onion, tomato and cucumber. | Add both chutneys and lemon juice. | Toss well. | Add sev and chaat masala. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: mixed fruits, lemon juice, chaat masala, black salt, rock salt, roasted cumin powder, coriander
method: Chop assorted fruits into cubes. | Mix with lemon juice. | Sprinkle chaat masala, black salt and cumin powder. | Toss gently. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve chilled.

ingredients: maida, potato, peas, ginger, green chilli, fennel seeds, coriander, amchur, oil, salt
method: Make dough with maida, ajwain and oil and rest for 30 minutes. | Boil and mash potatoes with spiced peas filling. | Divide dough and roll into ovals, cut in half. | Shape each half into a cone and fill with potato mixture. | Seal edges firmly with water. | Deep fry on medium-low heat until golden and crispy. | Serve with mint and tamarind chutney.

ingredients: white bread, besan, potato, green chilli, coriander, ajwain, red chilli powder, oil, salt
method: Make thick besan batter with spices and salt. | Optionally prepare potato filling with spices. | Spread filling between two bread slices as a sandwich. | Cut into triangles or keep whole. | Dip bread in besan batter coating all sides. | Deep fry until golden and crispy. | Serve hot with green chutney.

ingredients: banana peppers, besan, rice flour, ajwain, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Wash and slit banana peppers vertically without cutting through. | Make filling with mashed potato, onion, lemon and spices. | Stuff peppers with filling. | Make thick besan batter with carom seeds and spices. | Coat stuffed peppers completely in batter. | Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. | Serve hot with coconut chutney.

ingredients: cooked white peas, puri, onion, tomato, green chutney, tamarind chutney, sev, chaat masala, coriander
method: Prepare spiced white peas masala. | Crush puris on plate. | Pour hot masala over puris. | Top with onion, tomato and chutneys. | Sprinkle sev and chaat masala. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: chana dal, green chilli, ginger, onion, curry leaves, fennel, oil, salt
method: Soak chana dal and grind coarsely. | Add onion, chilli, ginger, curry leaves and fennel. | Shape into flat rounds. | Deep fry until crispy and golden. | Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: rice flour, urad dal flour, sesame seeds, cumin, butter, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour and urad dal flour with sesame, cumin and butter. | Add water to form smooth dough. | Press through murukku mould into hot oil. | Deep fry until crisp and golden. | Cool and store.

ingredients: rice flour, urad dal flour, butter, sesame seeds, cumin, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Mix flours with butter, sesame and spices. | Add water to form smooth dough. | Shape into spirals using chakli mould. | Deep fry until crisp. | Cool and store in airtight container.

ingredients: besan, oil, ajwain, salt, water
method: Mix besan with ajwain, salt and oil. | Add water to form soft dough. | Press through sev press into hot oil. | Fry until crisp and golden. | Cool and store.

ingredients: rice flour, chana dal, urad dal flour, sesame, curry leaves, red chilli, butter, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour with dals, sesame, curry leaves and butter. | Add water to form stiff dough. | Flatten into thin discs. | Deep fry until crisp. | Cool and store.

ingredients: rice flour, besan, sesame seeds, butter, red chilli, cumin, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour and besan with sesame, butter and spices. | Press through ribbon mould into hot oil. | Fry until crisp and golden. | Cool and store.

ingredients: potato, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, turmeric, besan batter, oil, salt
