method: Boil and mash potatoes with mustard seed tempering. | Add onion, green chilli, coriander and lemon juice. | Mix until combined and shape into round balls. | Make besan batter with turmeric and salt. | Coat potato balls in batter. | Deep fry until golden brown and crispy. | Serve with coconut chutney.

ingredients: maize grains, moong dal, ghee, cumin, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, salt
method: Soak maize overnight and pressure cook. | Cook moong dal separately. | Temper cumin, ginger and green chilli in ghee. | Add both and mix. | Season with turmeric and salt. | Serve with ghee.

ingredients: pearl millet (bajra), moong dal, ghee, cumin, garlic, ginger, salt
method: Soak bajra overnight. | Pressure cook with moong dal. | Temper cumin, garlic and ginger in ghee. | Mix into khichdi. | Serve hot with ghee and pickle.

ingredients: sabudana, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, cashews, raisins
method: Soak sabudana and drain. | Boil milk and add sabudana. | Cook until translucent. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Garnish with cashews and raisins. | Serve warm.

ingredients: thin vermicelli, milk, sugar, ghee, cardamom, saffron, cashews, almonds
method: Roast vermicelli in ghee until golden. | Add milk and cook until soft. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Simmer until thick. | Garnish with nuts. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: bottle gourd, milk, sugar, ghee, cardamom, cashews, raisins
method: Peel and grate bottle gourd squeezing excess water. | Cook grated lauki in milk until soft and milk reduces. | Add sugar and stir continuously on low flame. | Add cardamom powder and a pinch of saffron. | Continue cooking until halwa thickens. | Add ghee and cook until it leaves the sides. | Garnish with cashews and serve warm.

ingredients: apple, sugar, ghee, cardamom, saffron, cashews
method: Grate apples. | Cook in ghee until all moisture evaporates. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Cook until thick. | Garnish with cashews. | Serve warm.

ingredients: white bread, milk, sugar, ghee, cardamom, saffron, almonds, cashews
method: Cut bread into small pieces and fry in ghee until golden. | Prepare sugar syrup of one-thread consistency. | Add saffron and cardamom to syrup. | Add fried bread pieces to syrup and mash. | Cook on low flame stirring until it comes together. | Add condensed milk for richness. | Garnish with dry fruits and serve warm.

ingredients: paneer, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, pistachios, rose water
method: Grate or crumble paneer. | Cook in milk with sugar. | Add cardamom, saffron and rose water. | Simmer until creamy. | Garnish with pistachios. | Serve chilled.

ingredients: mango pulp, yogurt, milk, sugar, cardamom, ice
method: Combine mango pulp with cold yogurt in a blender. | Add sugar or honey to taste. | Add a pinch of cardamom powder. | Blend until very smooth and frothy. | Add cold milk if needed to adjust consistency. | Pour into chilled glasses. | Garnish with a slice of mango or pistachio.

ingredients: yogurt, milk, sugar, cardamom, rose water, ice
method: Whisk yogurt until smooth. | Add milk, sugar and cardamom. | Add rose water and blend. | Serve chilled with ice.

ingredients: milk, almonds, cashews, pistachios, fennel, pepper, poppy seeds, cardamom, rose petals, sugar, saffron
method: Soak almonds, cashews, melon seeds and poppy seeds overnight. | Blend with peppercorns, fennel seeds, cardamom and rose petals. | Grind to a very smooth paste using milk. | Strain the paste through a fine sieve. | Mix strained liquid with cold milk and sugar. | Add kesar and mix. | Serve very cold with ice and rose water.

ingredients: raw mango, sugar, roasted cumin, black salt, mint, water, ice
method: Boil raw mango and extract pulp. | Blend with sugar, cumin and black salt. | Add mint and cold water. | Adjust seasoning. | Serve chilled with ice.

ingredients: yogurt, water, roasted cumin, green chilli, ginger, coriander, black salt
method: Whisk yogurt with water until smooth. | Add cumin, green chilli, ginger and black salt. | Mix well. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve chilled.

ingredients: bael fruit pulp, sugar, black salt, roasted cumin, water, ice
method: Extract bael pulp and mix with water. | Strain to remove seeds. | Add sugar, black salt and cumin. | Mix well. | Serve chilled with ice.

ingredients: kokum, sugar, black salt, cumin, ginger, water
method: Soak kokum in water until soft. | Extract the liquid and strain. | Add sugar, black salt and cumin. | Add grated ginger. | Serve chilled as a digestive.

ingredients: tea leaves, milk, water, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, pepper, sugar
method: Crush ginger, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon coarsely. | Boil water and add the crushed spices. | Simmer for 2 minutes until fragrant. | Add tea leaves and boil for a minute. | Pour in milk and bring to a rolling boil. | Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes. | Strain into cups and add sugar to taste.

ingredients: milk, turmeric, ginger, black pepper, cinnamon, honey
method: Heat milk. | Add turmeric, ginger, pepper and cinnamon. | Stir and heat until fragrant. | Strain if desired. | Add honey and serve warm.

ingredients: full fat milk, saffron, sugar, cardamom, pistachios, almonds
method: Soak saffron in warm milk. | Heat remaining milk. | Add saffron milk, sugar and cardamom. | Stir well. | Garnish with nuts. | Serve warm or cold.

ingredients: yogurt, cucumber, cumin, black salt, green chilli, coriander, mint
method: Whisk yogurt until smooth. | Grate or chop cucumber. | Mix into yogurt. | Add roasted cumin, black salt and green chilli. | Garnish with coriander and mint. | Serve chilled.

ingredients: yogurt, boondi, cumin, black salt, red chilli powder, coriander
method: Soak readymade boondi in water for 5 minutes until soft. | Squeeze out excess water gently. | Whisk yogurt until smooth and creamy. | Add salt, roasted cumin powder and black salt. | Mix in the softened boondi. | Add chopped coriander and green chilli. | Garnish with red chilli powder and serve chilled.

ingredients: yogurt, boiled potato, cumin, black salt, green chilli, coriander, red chilli powder
method: Boil potatoes until just tender and cool completely. | Peel and cut into small cubes. | Whisk yogurt until smooth with salt and cumin powder. | Add black salt and chaat masala. | Fold in potato cubes and green chilli. | Add roasted cumin powder and coriander. | Serve chilled garnished with red chilli powder.

ingredients: mint leaves, coriander, green chilli, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, salt
method: Blend mint, coriander, green chilli, ginger and garlic. | Add lemon juice and salt. | Blend to smooth paste. | Adjust consistency. | Serve fresh.

ingredients: tamarind, jaggery, cumin, ginger powder, black salt, red chilli, water
method: Soak tamarind in warm water and extract thick pulp. | Cook tamarind pulp with jaggery on low flame. | Add roasted cumin powder, black salt and dry ginger. | Add red chilli powder to taste. | Simmer until chutney thickens to coating consistency. | Cool completely and store in a jar. | Use as a dipping sauce or chaat topping.

ingredients: grated coconut, green chilli, ginger, roasted chana, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Blend coconut with chilli, ginger and roasted chana. | Add water and blend smooth. | Add salt. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix into chutney. | Serve with idli or dosa.

ingredients: tomato, onion, dry red chilli, garlic, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, garlic and tomatoes. | Add dry red chilli and cook. | Cool and blend. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix into chutney. | Serve.

ingredients: roasted peanuts, green chilli, garlic, tamarind, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Blend roasted peanuts with green chilli, garlic and tamarind. | Add water and salt and blend smooth. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix into chutney. | Serve.

ingredients: gongura (sorrel) leaves, dry red chilli, garlic, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Wash gongura leaves and dry completely. | Heat oil and fry dried red chillies, garlic and cumin. | Add gongura leaves and fry until wilted. | Cool completely and grind coarsely. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Pour tempering over ground chutney. | Serve with rice or as a condiment.

ingredients: garlic, red chilli powder, tamarind, cumin, oil, salt
method: Grind garlic cloves with red chilli, cumin and salt. | Add tamarind water. | Mix to thick paste. | Heat oil and mix in. | Serve with roti or chaat.

ingredients: dried mint, red chilli, cumin, fennel, amchur, black salt
method: Dry roast dried mint leaves until crisp. | Dry roast cumin seeds and dried red chillies. | Cool completely and grind to a coarse powder. | Add black salt, amchur and sugar and mix. | Store in an airtight container. | Use as a dry chutney with snacks. | Can be sprinkled on chaats directly.

ingredients: potato, pickling spices (mustard, fennel, fenugreek, nigella), yogurt, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and temper pickling spices. | Add boiled potato cubes. | Add yogurt, red chilli and salt. | Cook until oil separates. | Serve hot with roti.

ingredients: small potatoes, tomato, onion, yogurt, cream, whole spices, garam masala, kasuri methi, oil, salt
method: Prick small potatoes all over with a fork and deep fry until golden. | Make paste by grinding onion, tomato, cashews and spices. | Heat oil and cook the paste until oil separates. | Add yogurt and cook stirring well. | Add fried potatoes and mix to coat. | Add water and pressure cook briefly or simmer covered. | Garnish with coriander and cream.

ingredients: small potatoes, fennel powder, ginger powder, dry red chilli, yogurt, asafoetida, mustard oil, salt
method: Deep fry small potatoes until golden and prick all over. | Prepare Kashmiri masala with fennel powder, dry ginger and whole spices. | Heat mustard oil and add whole spices. | Add whisked yogurt mixed with Kashmiri red chilli paste. | Cook on low flame until oil separates. | Add fried potatoes and mix. | Cook on dum adding a little water until potatoes are fully cooked.

ingredients: paneer, khoya, cashews, cream, onion paste, whole spices, saffron, rose water, oil, salt
method: Grate paneer and mix with spices and dry fruits for koftas. | Shape into round balls and deep fry until golden. | Make rich Mughlai gravy with onion paste, cashew paste and cream. | Heat ghee and add whole spices. | Cook the onion-cashew paste until fragrant. | Add tomato puree and cook until thick. | Add cream and koftas and simmer gently.

ingredients: nine mixed vegetables and dry fruits, onion, cashews, cream, whole spices, saffron, oil, salt
method: Fry paneer and mixed vegetables separately in oil or ghee. | Make rich paste by grinding onion, cashews and poppy seeds. | Heat ghee and add whole spices. | Cook the paste until golden and fragrant. | Add cream, saffron milk and sugar. | Add all fried vegetables and paneer. | Simmer gently and garnish with dry fruits.

ingredients: basmati rice, mixed vegetables, fried onion, saffron, yogurt, whole spices, ghee, rose water, mint, salt
method: Marinate vegetables in yogurt and spices. | Partially cook rice. | Layer vegetables and rice. | Add saffron, fried onion, ghee and rose water. | Seal and cook on dum. | Serve with raita.

ingredients: cooked rice, mixed vegetables, pav bhaji masala, onion, tomato, butter, coriander, lemon, salt
method: Cook rice and keep aside. | Heat butter on a tawa and add pav bhaji masala. | Add onion, tomato and capsicum and cook on high flame. | Add peas, boiled potato cubes and spices. | Toss vegetables well on high heat. | Add rice and mix lightly. | Serve topped with butter and chopped coriander.

ingredients: kidney beans, rice, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Soak and pressure cook rajma. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic, tomatoes. | Add spices and cooked rajma. | Simmer until thick. | Serve with steamed rice and pickle.

ingredients: rice, toor dal, moong dal, turmeric, cumin, ghee, asafoetida, salt
method: Wash rice and moong dal together. | Heat ghee in a pressure cooker and add cumin seeds. | Add onion and saute briefly. | Add ginger, turmeric and salt. | Add rice and dal mixture and water. | Pressure cook for 3 whistles until soft and mushy. | Prepare tempering of ghee, cumin, dry chilli and asafoetida and pour over.

ingredients: rice, moong dal, mixed vegetables, cumin, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, garam masala, ghee, salt
method: SautÃ© cumin, ginger and vegetables in ghee. | Add rice, dal, turmeric and spices. | Add water and cook until soft. | Finish with ghee. | Serve hot with papad and pickle.

ingredients: maida, green peas, ginger, green chilli, cumin, fennel, asafoetida, oil, salt
method: Make filling with fresh or dried peas, ginger and spices. | Grind or mash peas coarsely with coriander. | Make dough with maida and oil and rest. | Stuff dough balls with pea filling and seal. | Roll gently into flat kachoris. | Deep fry on medium heat until golden and crispy. | Serve with tamarind chutney.

ingredients: maida, urad dal, fennel, cumin, asafoetida, oil, salt
method: Make filling with moong dal mixed with spices and dry mango powder. | Knead maida with oil and a pinch of salt into a stiff dough. | Stuff dough balls with dal filling. | Roll gently without seams showing. | Deep fry on low flame until very crispy and golden. | Drain well. | Serve with tamarind chutney.

ingredients: maida, onion, fennel, dry red chilli, coriander, amchur, oil, salt
method: Prepare dough with maida and oil. | SautÃ© onion with fennel, chilli and spices for filling. | Cool and stuff into dough. | Deep fry until golden and crisp. | Serve hot with tamarind chutney.

ingredients: maida, ghee, ajwain, black pepper, salt
method: Mix maida with ghee, ajwain, pepper and salt. | Add water to form stiff dough. | Roll thin and cut into shapes. | Deep fry on low heat until crisp. | Store in airtight container.

ingredients: maida, nigella seeds, ghee, salt
method: Mix maida with ghee, nigella seeds and salt. | Add water and knead stiff dough. | Roll thin and cut into diamond shapes. | Deep fry until crisp. | Store and serve.

ingredients: maida, sugar, ghee, cardamom, oil
method: Mix maida with oil, sugar and cardamom powder. | Knead into a stiff dough using water. | Roll out into a thick sheet. | Cut into diamond or square shapes. | Deep fry on medium-low heat until golden. | Drain on paper towels. | Cool completely before storing.

ingredients: maida, khoya, sugar, cardamom, cashews, raisins, coconut, ghee, oil
method: Make pastry dough with maida and ghee and rest. | Make filling with khoya, sugar, coconut and dry fruits. | Roll dough thin and cut into circles. | Fill one half with khoya mixture and fold over. | Seal edges by crimping or pressing. | Deep fry in ghee until golden brown. | Soak in sugar syrup or dust with icing sugar.

ingredients: maida, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, poppy seeds, oil
method: Prepare dough with maida, ghee and a pinch of salt. | Make filling with coconut, jaggery, sesame seeds and cardamom. | Roll dough into small circles. | Place filling on one half and fold over. | Seal edges firmly by crimping with a fork. | Deep fry on medium heat until golden. | Cool and store.

ingredients: cashews, almonds, pistachios, sugar, ghee, cardamom
method: Chop all dry fruits including cashews, almonds, pistachios and dates. | Heat ghee and add the chopped dry fruits. | Roast lightly until fragrant. | Add condensed milk and mix well. | Cook stirring until mixture thickens and leaves the pan. | Add cardamom and saffron. | Press into a greased tray, cool and cut into pieces.

ingredients: peanuts, jaggery, ghee
method: Dry roast peanuts until light golden and rub off skins. | Heat jaggery with a little water to hard crack stage. | Test by dropping a drop in cold water. | Add roasted peanuts and mix quickly off heat. | Pour onto a greased surface and flatten with a rolling pin. | Cut into rectangles while still warm. | Cool completely until hard and brittle.

ingredients: sesame seeds, jaggery, ghee
method: Dry roast sesame seeds until golden. | Heat jaggery with water to hard crack stage. | Test consistency in cold water. | Add roasted sesame seeds and mix quickly. | Pour onto greased surface and spread thin. | Cut into pieces while still warm. | Cool completely until hard and store.

ingredients: besan, yogurt, turmeric, green chilli paste, ginger, lemon juice, baking soda, mustard seeds, curry leaves, sugar, oil, salt
method: Mix besan with curd, ginger-chilli paste and lemon juice. | Add water to make a smooth thick batter. | Add eno fruit salt and mix gently. | Pour into a greased steaming tray immediately. | Steam for 15 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. | Cool for 5 minutes and cut into squares. | Pour tempering of oil, mustard, curry leaves and green chilli over.

ingredients: rice, mixed dals, grated bottle gourd, sesame, fenugreek, onion, green chilli, ginger, oil, salt
method: Soak and grind rice and dals. | Ferment batter overnight. | Add grated lauki, onion, spices. | Pour in greased pan. | Top with sesame and bake or cook on tawa. | Serve with chutney.

ingredients: wheat flour, besan, fenugreek leaves, yogurt, turmeric, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Mix both flours with methi, yogurt and spices. | Knead soft dough. | Roll thin and cook on tawa with oil. | Cook until golden on both sides. | Serve with pickle and yogurt.

ingredients: surti papdi, sweet potato, baby brinjal, raw banana, potato, muthia (fenugreek dumplings), coconut, green garlic, spices, oil
method: Prepare muthia with besan and methi. | Stuff brinjals with spice paste. | Layer all vegetables and muthia. | Add coconut, green garlic and oil. | Cook on slow heat until done. | Serve hot.

ingredients: tomatoes, sev, sugar, turmeric, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric and salt. | Cook until tomatoes are soft. | Add sugar. | Top generously with sev. | Serve immediately.

ingredients: brinjal, peanuts, sesame, coconut, tamarind, jaggery, spices, mustard oil, salt
method: Stuff brinjal with ground peanut, sesame and coconut mixture. | Heat oil and temper spices. | Add stuffed brinjals and cover. | Cook on low heat until tender. | Add tamarind and jaggery. | Serve.

ingredients: potato, mustard seeds, turmeric, sugar, lemon juice, green chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add diced boiled potato. | Add turmeric, green chilli and salt. | Add sugar and lemon juice. | Toss and serve warm.

ingredients: bottle gourd, besan, yogurt, onion, tomato, garam masala, cream, oil, salt
method: Grate bottle gourd and squeeze out water. | Mix with besan, spices and coriander to form kofta mixture. | Shape into balls and deep fry until golden. | Make onion-tomato-cashew gravy. | Cook gravy until oil separates. | Add cream or coconut milk. | Add koftas just before serving and simmer gently.

ingredients: raw peanuts, jaggery, sesame, dry coconut, oil, salt
method: Roast peanuts until crunchy. | Melt jaggery and cook until sticky. | Add peanuts, sesame and coconut. | Mix quickly. | Pour on greased surface and flatten. | Cool and cut.

ingredients: onion, besan, green chilli, coriander, ajwain, red chilli powder, oil, salt
method: Slice onions thinly into half rings. | Make a thick besan batter with spices and green chilli. | Add onion rings to the batter and mix well. | Drop spoonfuls of batter with onions into hot oil. | Fry until deep golden and crispy. | Drain on paper towels. | Serve immediately with green chutney.

ingredients: semolina, onion, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, cashews, oil, salt
method: Roast semolina and keep aside. | Temper mustard seeds, urad dal and cashews. | SautÃ© onion, chilli and ginger. | Add water and bring to boil. | Add rava slowly while stirring. | Cover and cook. | Serve hot.

ingredients: rice, urad dal, poha, fenugreek seeds, salt, oil
method: Soak and grind rice, dal, poha and fenugreek. | Ferment batter overnight. | Pour thick rounds on hot tawa. | Cover and cook until set. | Serve three in a set with chutney and sambar.

ingredients: raw rice, grated coconut, water, salt, oil
method: Soak raw rice for 4-6 hours and grind to a very thin batter. | Add water to make it almost watery in consistency. | Add salt and mix. | Heat a non-stick tawa and grease lightly. | Pour batter and swirl to spread very thin. | Cover and cook briefly until done. | Fold gently and serve with coconut chutney.

ingredients: idli/dosa batter, onion, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil
method: Add tempered onion, chilli and spices to batter. | Heat paniyaram pan and grease. | Pour batter into cavities. | Cook on medium heat, flip with stick. | Cook until golden on both sides. | Serve with chutney.

ingredients: raw rice, grated coconut, yeast, sugar, salt
method: Soak raw rice and grind with coconut and a little cooked rice. | Add toddy or yeast and ferment overnight. | The batter should be smooth and slightly sour. | Heat an appam tawa and grease lightly. | Pour a ladle of batter and swirl in a circular motion. | Cover and cook until center is set and edges are lacy. | Serve with stew or coconut milk.

ingredients: rice flour, grated coconut, salt, water
method: Mix rice flour with salt and a little water until crumbly. | The texture should be like damp sand. | Layer coconut and rice flour alternately in the puttu maker. | Steam for 7-10 minutes until cooked through. | Unmould by pushing the piston. | Serve immediately while hot. | Serve with kadala curry or banana and sugar.

ingredients: black chickpeas, coconut, dry red chilli, coriander seeds, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Soak black chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until soft. | Roast coconut with spices and onion until dark brown. | Grind the roasted mixture to a paste. | Heat coconut oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and saute until golden. | Add chickpeas and coconut paste with water. | Simmer until thick and serve with appam or puttu.

ingredients: toor dal, tamarind, vegetables, roasted coconut, red chilli, coriander seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Roast coconut, spices and lentils until dark and grind to paste. | Cook toor dal until soft. | Prepare tamarind extract. | Cook vegetables of choice. | Combine dal, tamarind and vegetables. | Add the roasted coconut paste and sambar powder. | Boil and add tempering of mustard seeds and curry leaves.

ingredients: ginger, tamarind, jaggery, dry red chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, fenugreek, oil, salt
method: Peel and finely chop or grind ginger to a paste. | Fry ginger paste in coconut oil until golden. | Add tamarind pulp and jaggery. | Mix in red chilli powder and salt. | Cook until thick and oil appears on surface. | Add tempering of mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Store and serve as a condiment.

ingredients: raw mango, coconut, green chilli, cumin, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chilli, coconut oil, salt
method: Cook raw mango until soft. | Grind coconut with green chilli and cumin. | Mix paste with mango. | Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and red chilli. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: ginger, tamarind, green chilli, jaggery, mustard seeds, fenugreek, curry leaves, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Sweet, Sour & Pungent

ingredients: yogurt, cucumber, grated coconut, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Mix yogurt with grated coconut, green chilli and ginger. | Add grated cucumber. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix into yogurt. | Serve chilled.

ingredients: cucumber, yogurt, coconut, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook cucumber briefly. | Grind coconut with chilli. | Mix cooked cucumber, coconut paste and yogurt. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Mix and serve as part of Kerala meal.

ingredients: fresh ginger, tamarind paste, jaggery, turmeric, green chilli, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Roast ginger in coconut oil until golden. | Make paste of green chilli and ginger. | Cook tamarind extract with jaggery and spices. | Add ginger-chilli paste and cook. | Add turmeric and red chilli powder. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds, curry leaves and dry red chilli. | Pour tempering and simmer until thick.

ingredients: cabbage, grated coconut, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Shred cabbage finely. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add cabbage, turmeric, green chilli and salt. | Cover and cook briefly. | Add coconut and mix. | Serve warm.

ingredients: moong dal, grated coconut, turmeric, green chilli, garlic, cumin, mustard seeds, curry leaves, coconut oil, salt
method: Cook moong dal with turmeric. | Grind coconut with chilli, garlic and cumin. | Add paste to dal. | Simmer. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: urad dal flour, black pepper, cumin, salt, oil
method: Mix urad dal flour with salt and asafoetida. | Knead into a very stiff dough. | Take tiny balls and roll paper thin using a rolling pin. | Sun dry or oven dry until completely crisp. | Store uncooked pappadams in an airtight container. | Deep fry in hot oil for a few seconds until they puff. | Or roast directly on flame until blistered.

ingredients: bitter gourd, besan, peanuts, grated coconut, sesame, coriander-cumin powder, jaggery, oil, salt
method: Scoop out karela and marinate. | Prepare filling with besan, peanuts, coconut and jaggery. | Stuff karela and tie with thread. | Shallow fry turning occasionally. | Serve hot with roti.

ingredients: lotus stem, carrot, peas, potato, onion, yogurt, garam masala, oil, salt
method: Cut all vegetables including lotus stem, turnip and cauliflower. | Heat oil or ghee and add whole spices. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add ginger-garlic paste and spices. | Add all vegetables and mix well. | Add yogurt and cook until oil separates. | Simmer until vegetables are tender.

ingredients: lotus stem, yogurt, fennel powder, ginger powder, asafoetida, cardamom, cloves, ghee, salt
method: Peel lotus stem and cut into slices. | Prepare yakhni stock by boiling water with whole spices. | Cook lotus stem in the spiced stock until tender. | Make yogurt sauce with fennel powder and dry ginger. | Mix yogurt with lotus stem and stock. | Heat ghee and add whole spices for tempering. | Pour tempering and simmer gently without boiling yogurt.

ingredients: knol-khol greens (haakh), mustard oil, dry red chilli, asafoetida, salt
method: Wash haakh leaves thoroughly. | Heat mustard oil in a pan until smoking point. | Add asafoetida and whole red chillies. | Add the washed haakh leaves and mix. | Add salt and a little water. | Cover and cook on low flame until tender. | Serve with rice as part of a Kashmiri meal.

ingredients: besan gatta, yogurt, onion, tomato, garam masala, cumin, oil, salt
method: Make besan gattas by kneading besan with spices and oil. | Roll into cylinders and boil in water until firm. | Cut into pieces when cooled. | Prepare yogurt-based gravy with onion and spices. | Heat oil and cook onion paste until golden. | Add yogurt and spices and cook. | Add gatta pieces and simmer until gravy coats them well.

ingredients: fenugreek leaves, green peas, cream, onion, cashews, ginger, garlic, garam masala, oil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion and garlic. | Add cashew paste and cook. | Add methi leaves and peas. | Add cream, spices and simmer. | Serve with paratha or naan.

ingredients: wheat flour, potato, fresh fenugreek, green chilli, ginger, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Mash potato with methi, green chilli, ginger and spices. | Make wheat flour dough. | Stuff and roll into parathas. | Cook on tawa with oil until golden. | Serve with curd and pickle.

ingredients: besan, vegetables (drumstick, potato, lotus stem), mustard seeds, fenugreek, tamarind, dry red chilli, oil, salt
method: Dry roast besan until golden and aromatic. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add the roasted besan and cook well. | Add water gradually stirring to avoid lumps. | Add tamarind water, turmeric and spices. | Add vegetables like drumstick and tomato. | Simmer until thick and vegetables are cooked.

ingredients: spinach, chana dal, potato, tomato, onion, garlic, cumin, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Cook chana dal until soft. | SautÃ© onion, garlic and spices. | Add tomato, potato and spinach. | Mix with dal and pressure cook. | Mash lightly and serve with rice.

ingredients: flaxseeds, dry red chilli, garlic, tamarind, salt
method: Dry roast flaxseeds until fragrant. | Grind with dry red chilli, garlic and tamarind. | Add salt and pulse. | Serve with rice and dal.

ingredients: rice flour, urad dal, salt, water, oil
method: Mix rice flour and urad dal flour in equal proportion. | Add salt and water to make a thick batter. | Heat an iron tawa and grease with oil. | Pour a ladleful of batter and spread into a circle. | Cook covered on medium flame until done. | Flip and cook briefly on other side. | Serve hot with chutney or dal.

ingredients: wild mushrooms (rugra), onion, tomato, turmeric, green chilli, mustard oil, salt
method: Clean mushrooms thoroughly. | Heat mustard oil until smoking. | Add onion and cook. | Add tomatoes, turmeric and chilli. | Add mushrooms and cook until tender. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: bamboo shoots, onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Boil bamboo shoots in salted water and drain to remove bitterness. | Heat oil and add dried red chillies and onion. | Cook until onion is golden brown. | Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato. | Add spices and cook until oil separates. | Add bamboo shoots and mix well. | Simmer with water until gravy thickens.

ingredients: red rice, onion, ginger, garlic, turmeric, black pepper, bay leaf, oil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, ginger and garlic in oil. | Add spices and rice. | Add water and cook until rice is done. | Season and serve as the traditional Khasi dish.

ingredients: boiled potato, onion, green chilli, ginger, lemon juice, salt, coriander
method: Cube boiled potatoes. | Mix with finely chopped onion, green chilli and ginger. | Add lemon juice and salt. | Toss well. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve as salad.

ingredients: bitter melon, onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger, turmeric, mustard oil, salt
method: Slice bitter melon thinly. | Heat mustard oil and fry onion. | Add ginger, tomatoes and spices. | Add bitter melon and cook. | Stir well and serve with rice.

ingredients: fermented fish (replaced with boiled potato/veg for veg version), green chilli, garlic, mustard oil, coriander, salt
method: Boil mixed vegetables like potato and yam until tender. | Mash vegetables coarsely. | Dry roast dried red chillies until charred. | Grind with fermented ingredients and salt. | Mix the ground paste into mashed vegetables. | Add mustard oil and mix well. | Serve as a side dish with rice.

ingredients: boiled mixed vegetables, fermented soybean paste, roasted green chilli, garlic, onion, oil, salt
method: Boil mixed vegetables until soft and mash coarsely. | Dry roast dried red chillies and grind to powder. | Mix chilli powder with fermented soybean paste. | Combine with mashed vegetables. | Add mustard oil and salt. | Mix in chopped green onion. | Serve as a side with steamed rice.

ingredients: maize flour, water, salt, chilli
method: Bring water to a boil in a heavy pot. | Slowly add maize flour while stirring continuously. | Stir vigorously to prevent lumps. | Cook on low flame for 20-25 minutes stirring often. | The mixture should become very thick and pull away from sides. | Cover and rest for 5 minutes. | Serve with dal or chutney.

ingredients: vegetables (bamboo shoot, beans), ginger, garlic, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Chop all vegetables. | SautÃ© ginger, garlic and chilli. | Add vegetables and toss. | Cook until tender and fragrant. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: taro leaves, dried yam, spices, oil, salt
method: Boil taro leaves and squeeze out water thoroughly. | Dry and ferment the cooked leaves for a few days. | Break the fermented leaves into pieces. | Cook in water with spices until soft. | Add salt and green chilli. | Heat oil and add tempering spices. | Pour over and serve with rice.

ingredients: rice, assorted vegetables, ginger, garlic, axone (fermented soybean), oil, salt
method: Cook rice until mushy. | SautÃ© ginger, garlic. | Add vegetables and axone. | Mix with rice and cook together. | Serve as a wholesome porridge.

ingredients: bamboo shoots, king chilli, fermented fish (veg version uses seasoning), garlic, oil, salt
method: Clean tender bamboo shoots thoroughly. | Slice into thin pieces. | Mix with salt and fermented paste. | Allow to pickle for at least 2-3 days. | The sourness will develop naturally. | Serve as a condiment or side dish. | Can be eaten fresh or after fermenting.

ingredients: vegetables (potato, tomato, drumstick), lemon, turmeric, mustard seeds, dry red chilli, oil, salt
method: Lightly fry potato and vegetables in mustard oil. | Heat more oil and add mustard seeds. | Add tomato, green chilli and turmeric. | Add fried vegetables and water. | Simmer for 10 minutes. | Add lemon or tomato for sour taste. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: raw papaya, raw banana peel ash (khar), mustard seeds, ginger, salt
method: Strain water through dried banana skin ash to get alkaline khar water. | Peel raw papaya and cut into pieces. | Cook papaya in khar water on low flame. | Add mustard oil and green chilli. | Season with salt. | Cook until papaya is completely soft. | Serve as a starter course in Assamese meal.

ingredients: cooked rice, water, mustard oil, onion, green chilli, salt
method: Soak cooked rice in water overnight until slightly fermented. | Drain partially. | Add mustard oil, chopped onion, green chilli and salt. | Mix and serve at room temperature.

ingredients: elephant apple, potato, mustard oil, onion, green chilli, salt
method: Boil potato and mash. | Cook elephant apple until soft. | Mix both with mustard oil, onion and chilli. | Blend roughly. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, dried red chilli, garlic, ginger, mustard oil, salt
method: Chop mixed vegetables into bite-sized pieces. | Heat oil and add whole spices. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato. | Cook until masala is well done. | Add vegetables and mix to coat. | Simmer with water until vegetables are tender.

ingredients: dried fermented greens (gundruk), potato, tomato, green chilli, garlic, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Soak dried fermented gundruk in water for 30 minutes. | Heat oil and add garlic and ginger. | Add onion and cook until soft. | Add tomato and green chilli. | Add soaked gundruk and fry briefly. | Add water and simmer for 15 minutes. | Season and serve with rice.

ingredients: round red chilli (dalle), garlic, lemon juice, salt
method: Wash round red Dalle chillies and slit slightly. | Heat mustard oil until smoking and cool slightly. | Add crushed garlic, ginger and salt. | Mix in the chillies and fermented ingredients. | Add lemon juice and mix well. | Allow to marinate for 2-3 days. | Serve as a fiery condiment.

ingredients: rice flour, banana, sugar, cardamom, fennel, ghee, oil
method: Mix rice flour with banana, sugar and spices. | Add water to form thick batter. | Pour in ring shapes into hot oil. | Deep fry until golden and crisp. | Serve as festive snack.

ingredients: dried chhurpi (yak cheese - veg substitute: paneer), vegetables, garlic, ginger, green chilli, broth, salt
method: Soak dried chhurpi until softened. | Simmer in vegetable broth. | Add garlic, ginger and chilli. | Add vegetables and cook. | Season and serve hot.

ingredients: noodles, vegetables, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, broth, green chilli, coriander, oil, salt
method: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender and drain. | Prepare clear vegetable broth with spices. | Chop vegetables and simmer in broth. | Add noodles to the broth. | Season with salt and soy sauce. | Add chopped spring onions and coriander. | Serve hot in bowls.

ingredients: maida, cabbage, carrot, onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper, salt
method: Make dough with maida and water and rest for 30 minutes. | Prepare filling with cabbage, carrot, onion, ginger and spices. | Roll dough thin and cut circles. | Place filling in center and pleat edges to seal. | Steam in a steamer for 15 minutes. | Serve hot with spicy tomato chutney. | Can also be pan-fried after steaming.

ingredients: millet or barley, yeast, water
method: Soak millet or barley for 24 hours. | Cook grains until soft and cool to room temperature. | Mix with fermented starter and water. | Store in a vessel for fermentation for 2-3 days. | Strain and serve cold. | The drink is mildly alcoholic with a tangy taste. | Traditionally served in bamboo mugs.

ingredients: barley flour, water, salt, butter
method: Mix barley flour with a little salt. | Add just enough water to make a stiff dough. | Knead until smooth and rest briefly. | Divide into portions and flatten into thick discs. | Cook on a hot dry pan on both sides. | The bread should be slightly charred. | Serve with butter tea or soup.

ingredients: roasted barley flour (tsampa), butter tea, salt
method: Roast barley flour until golden and nutty. | Boil water or milk in a pot. | Gradually add tsampa flour while stirring. | Cook on low flame stirring to prevent lumps. | Add salt or sugar and butter. | Adjust consistency with more liquid. | Serve hot as a warming breakfast.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, turnip, peas, potato, onion, garlic, ginger, oil, salt
method: Knead wheat flour with water into a stiff dough. | Pull small pieces and flatten into thumb-sized discs. | Boil in water until they float. | Add seasonal vegetables and simmer. | Prepare a stew with turnip, onion and peas. | Season with salt and spices. | Serve hot as a hearty stew.

ingredients: noodles, mixed vegetables, onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, broth, pepper, salt
method: Prepare vegetable broth with onion, garlic and spices. | Add chopped vegetables like carrot, cabbage and beans. | Cook noodles separately and drain. | Add cooked noodles to the broth. | Season with soy sauce and salt. | Add chopped spring onion and coriander. | Serve very hot in bowls.

ingredients: dried curd cheese (churpe), potato, onion, green chilli, turmeric, mustard oil, salt
method: Soak dried chhurpi in water to soften. | Cut into cubes when soft. | Heat oil and add onion and garlic. | Cook until golden then add tomato. | Add spices and cook until oil separates. | Add soaked chhurpi pieces and water. | Simmer until gravy thickens and serve.

ingredients: spinach, fenugreek leaves, rice flour, garlic, ginger, coriander, ghee, salt
method: Wash spinach and fenugreek leaves thoroughly. | Blanch and blend to a smooth paste. | Heat mustard oil and add garlic and dry chilli. | Add rice paste for thickening. | Add the green paste and mix well. | Add water and simmer on low flame. | Season with salt and serve with rice.

ingredients: mixed dals (gahat, masoor), onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger, garlic, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Soak and pressure cook dals. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic, tomato. | Add spices and dal. | Simmer until thick. | Serve with bhatt rice.

ingredients: black soybean (bhatt), garlic, ginger, tomato, turmeric, cumin, mustard oil, salt
method: Soak bhatt overnight and pressure cook. | Heat mustard oil. | SautÃ© garlic, ginger and tomato. | Add spices and cooked bhatt. | Simmer until gravy thickens. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: khoya, grated coconut, sugar, cardamom, maalu leaf (cone-shaped leaf)
method: Mix khoya with coconut, sugar and cardamom. | Cook until thick. | Roll maalu leaves into cones. | Fill with khoya mixture. | Seal and serve as fragrant sweet.

ingredients: rice flour, jaggery, sesame seeds, oil
method: Soak rice overnight and grind to a fine paste. | Mix with jaggery and sesame seeds. | The batter should be thick and pourable. | Heat oil in a wide pan. | Pour ladlefuls of batter and fry on low heat. | Fry until deep golden brown on both sides. | Drain and store in dry conditions.

ingredients: barnyard millet (jhangora), milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, cashews
method: Soak jhangora for 30 minutes. | Boil milk. | Add jhangora and cook on low heat. | Add sugar, cardamom and saffron. | Garnish with cashews. | Serve warm or cold.

ingredients: horse gram (gahat), onion, tomato, garlic, turmeric, cumin, mustard oil, salt
method: Soak and pressure cook horse gram. | Heat mustard oil. | SautÃ© garlic, onion and tomato. | Add turmeric and cumin. | Add cooked dal and simmer. | Serve with roti.

ingredients: boiled potato, cumin, red chilli, coriander powder, oil, salt
method: Boil potatoes until just done and peel. | Cut into cubes or halves. | Heat mustard oil until smoking point. | Add cumin seeds, coriander and dry red chilli. | Add potato pieces and toss well. | Add turmeric, red chilli and coriander powder. | Cook on high flame until potatoes are crispy.

ingredients: finger millet (mandua/ragi) flour, water, salt, ghee
method: Mix finger millet flour with salt. | Add warm water gradually and knead into a stiff dough. | The dough will be darker and slightly rough. | Make small balls and flatten with fingers or rolling pin. | Cook on dry hot tawa on both sides. | Apply ghee generously. | Serve hot with dal or leafy vegetable.

ingredients: colocasia leaves, besan, coconut, tamarind, jaggery, sesame, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Wash colocasia leaves and remove tough stems. | Roll leaves with filling of coconut and spices. | Tie rolls with thread or secure with stem. | Steam rolls until cooked through. | Prepare curry base with onion, tomato and coconut. | Add steamed rolls to the curry. | Simmer briefly and serve.

ingredients: pointed gourd, onion, green chilli, mustard seeds, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Cut pointed gourd and remove seeds. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds. | SautÃ© onion and green chilli. | Add parwal, turmeric and salt. | Cover and cook until tender. | Serve warm.

ingredients: bitter gourd, raw banana, drumstick, potato, milk, mustard paste, panch phoron, oil, salt
method: Cut bitter gourd and other vegetables into pieces. | Heat mustard oil and fry bitter gourd until golden. | Add other vegetables and fry briefly. | Add panch phoron and dry chilli tempering. | Add mustard paste and milk. | Season with sugar and salt. | Simmer until vegetables are tender.

ingredients: poppy seeds, potato, green chilli, salt, oil
method: Soak poppy seeds and grind to a smooth paste. | Mix with chopped onion, green chilli and salt. | Add a little besan to bind. | Shape into flat cutlets. | Shallow fry in mustard oil until golden on both sides. | Drain and serve warm. | Serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: potato, poppy seeds paste, green chilli, mustard oil, panch phoron, salt
method: Peel and cut potatoes into cubes. | Soak poppy seeds and grind with green chilli. | Heat mustard oil and add kalonji. | Add potato cubes and fry until lightly golden. | Add the poppy seed paste and mix. | Add turmeric and salt. | Add water and cook covered until potatoes are done.

ingredients: masoor dal, panch phoron, dry red chilli, garlic, mustard oil, turmeric, salt
method: Wash masoor dal and pressure cook until soft. | Heat mustard oil and add panch phoron. | Let spices crackle in the oil. | Add dry red chillies and bay leaf. | Pour the dal and mix. | Add water to adjust consistency. | Simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

ingredients: mixed vegetables (pumpkin, potato, raw banana, brinjal), panch phoron, ginger, ghee, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Cut pumpkin, potato, brinjal, radish and banana into chunks. | Heat oil and add panch phoron and bay leaf. | Add all vegetables and mix. | Add ginger paste, turmeric and salt. | Cook covered on low flame. | Add a little water if needed. | Cook until all vegetables are soft and serve.

ingredients: banana flower, potato, coconut, ginger, dry red chilli, panch phoron, oil, salt
method: Clean banana flower removing outer layers and black stamen. | Boil in salted water with turmeric until soft. | Squeeze out excess water and chop finely. | Heat oil and add whole spices. | Add coconut, potato and banana flower. | Cook with spices until dry. | Finish with ghee and garam masala.

ingredients: white peas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, tamarind, oil, salt
method: Soak and boil white peas. | SautÃ© onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and spices. | Add cooked peas and tamarind. | Simmer until thick. | Serve as street food snack.

ingredients: chana dal, coconut, raisins, ghee, dry red chilli, bay leaf, cumin, turmeric, ginger, salt
method: Cook chana dal until tender. | Temper bay leaf, cumin, red chilli in ghee. | Add cooked dal and ginger. | Add coconut pieces and raisins. | Simmer briefly. | Serve with luchi.

ingredients: brinjal, turmeric, red chilli powder, mustard oil, salt
method: Slice brinjal into rounds. | Marinate with turmeric, chilli and salt. | Shallow fry in mustard oil. | Cook until golden on both sides. | Serve with rice and dal.

ingredients: toor dal, raw mango, turmeric, mustard seeds, dry red chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook dal with raw mango and turmeric. | Temper mustard seeds, dry red chilli and curry leaves. | Mix tempering into dal. | Season and simmer. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: toor dal, raw papaya, brinjal, potato, raw banana, cumin, dry red chilli, ghee, salt
method: Wash toor dal and pressure cook with vegetables like raw papaya and pumpkin. | Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin and dry chilli. | Add the cooked dal and vegetables. | Mash slightly and mix. | Add water to adjust consistency. | Season with salt and turmeric. | Serve with steamed rice as Odisha's comfort food.

ingredients: mustard paste, vegetables, green chilli, garlic, turmeric, panch phoron, oil, salt
method: Soak and grind mustard seeds with green chilli and garlic to a paste. | Cook vegetables of choice in water until tender. | Heat mustard oil and add panch phoron. | Add vegetables and mustard paste. | Add turmeric and salt and mix. | Simmer on low flame for 10 minutes. | Serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: leafy greens (spinach/amaranth), garlic, dry red chilli, mustard oil, salt
method: Wash leafy greens thoroughly. | Heat mustard oil until smoking point. | Add dry red chilli and garlic. | Add the greens and toss on high flame. | Season with salt and turmeric. | Cook briefly until just wilted. | Serve with dal and rice.

ingredients: rice, black gram, salt, oil
method: Soak rice overnight and grind to a smooth batter. | Add black gram paste and salt. | Ferment overnight. | Pour thin crepe-like rounds on a hot tawa. | Cook until edges lift and surface is set. | No need to flip. | Serve with coconut chutney.

ingredients: rice flour, jaggery, sesame seeds, oil
method: Soak rice and grind to a fine paste. | Add jaggery and mix to a thick batter. | Add sesame seeds and cardamom. | Heat oil in a deep pan. | Drop spoonfuls of batter and fry on low heat. | Fry until deep golden brown. | Cool and store.

ingredients: chenna, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron
method: Make fresh chenna from full fat milk. | Knead chenna until smooth. | Shape into small balls. | Prepare thin sugar syrup. | Cook chenna balls in syrup until they expand. | Prepare thickened sweetened milk separately. | Place chenna balls in sweetened milk and chill.

ingredients: chenna, maida, sugar, cardamom, condensed milk, saffron, oil
method: Make chenna from full fat milk and knead smooth. | Shape into flat oval discs. | Deep fry until reddish brown. | Prepare sweetened milk with cardamom and saffron. | Soak fried rasabali in the sweetened milk. | Allow to absorb the flavors for an hour. | Serve at room temperature or chilled.

ingredients: finger millet (ragi) flour, water, salt
method: Bring water to a boil in a pot. | Add a little ragi flour and stir to prevent lumps. | When water boils again add remaining flour at once. | Stir vigorously with a wooden spatula. | Cook on low flame turning the mass. | When it forms a smooth non-sticky ball it is done. | Serve immediately with sambar or saaru.

ingredients: jowar flour, water, salt, oil
method: Mix jowar flour with salt. | Add warm water and knead into a pliable dough. | Make small balls and flatten with a rolling pin on plastic. | Transfer to a hot dry tawa. | Sprinkle water on top and cook covered. | Flip and cook other side. | Apply ghee and serve hot with curry.

ingredients: small brinjal, peanuts, sesame, coconut, tamarind, jaggery, spices, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Sweet, Sour & Spiced

ingredients: carrot, beans or cabbage, grated coconut, mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Peel and grate carrot or cut vegetables into thin pieces. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and urad dal. | Add curry leaves and dry red chilli. | Add onion and saute until soft. | Add vegetables and mix well. | Add salt, turmeric and coconut. | Cook briefly until vegetables are just done.

ingredients: toor dal, tomato, tamarind, saaru powder, mustard seeds, curry leaves, garlic, ghee, coriander, salt
method: Cook dal until soft. | Combine with tamarind, tomato and saaru powder. | Simmer until thin. | Temper with ghee, mustard, garlic and curry leaves. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: cooked rice, tamarind, peanuts, sesame, dried red chillies, chana dal, curry leaves, mustard seeds, oil, salt
method: Prepare tamarind-based puliyogare gojju. | Fry peanuts, sesame and chana dal. | Mix gojju with cooked rice. | Add tempering and peanuts. | Serve as temple prasad or picnic rice.

ingredients: cooked rice, lemon juice, peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, curry leaves, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add peanuts and fry. | Add turmeric, green chilli and cooked rice. | Add lemon juice and mix. | Serve at room temperature.

ingredients: yogurt, vegetables (ash gourd), grated coconut, green chilli, ginger, cumin, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Cook ash gourd until tender. | Grind coconut, chilli, ginger and cumin. | Mix with yogurt and pour over vegetable. | Heat gently without boiling. | Temper and serve.

ingredients: fresh fenugreek leaves, onion, garlic, turmeric, coconut, mustard seeds, oil, salt
method: Wash fresh fenugreek leaves and chop roughly. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and urad dal. | Add curry leaves and green chilli. | Add onion and saute until soft. | Add fenugreek leaves and mix. | Add salt, turmeric and a pinch of sugar to balance bitterness. | Cook until dry and serve.

ingredients: brinjal or tomato, tamarind, jaggery, mustard seeds, curry leaves, sambar powder, sesame, oil, salt
method: Roast and cook brinjal or tomato. | Add tamarind, jaggery and spices. | Simmer until thick. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Serve as tangy-sweet relish.

ingredients: thin crisp wafer rice rotis, coconut-based vegetable curry, spices, coconut oil
method: Prepare thin crisp rice rotis or use ready-made ones. | Make a rich coconut-based curry with vegetables or lentils. | Prepare tempering with coconut oil and spices. | Cook curry until thick and fragrant. | Break crisp rotis into large pieces on a plate. | Pour hot curry over the rotis. | Serve immediately before rotis become too soggy.

ingredients: rice, toor dal, mixed vegetables, tamarind, jaggery, bisi bele bath masala, ghee, cashews, salt
method: Cook rice and dal together. | Add tamarind, jaggery, vegetables and masala. | Simmer until well blended. | Add ghee and cashews on top. | Serve hot.

ingredients: gobindobhog rice, date palm jaggery (nolen gur), milk, cardamom
method: Wash gobindobhog rice and soak for 20 minutes. | Boil full fat milk and reduce to three-quarters. | Add soaked rice and cook on low flame stirring often. | Cook until rice is soft and milk is creamy. | Remove from heat and let cool slightly. | Add liquid date palm jaggery and stir gently. | Serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: gobindobhog rice, ghee, whole spices, sugar, raisins, cashews
method: Wash gobindobhog rice and soak briefly. | Heat ghee and add whole spices. | Add the rice and fry for 2 minutes. | Add hot water, salt and a pinch of sugar. | Cook covered until rice is done. | The sweetness should be subtle. | Serve with vegetable curry or kosha.

ingredients: raw banana, mustard paste, green chilli, garlic, mustard oil, salt
method: Boil raw banana and mash. | Mix with mustard paste, green chilli and garlic. | Add mustard oil and salt. | Mix thoroughly. | Serve as side with rice.

ingredients: pointed gourd, paneer, cashews, raisins, coconut, spices, oil, salt
method: Peel pointed gourds and scoop out seeds to create a hollow. | Prepare filling with paneer, spices and dry fruits. | Stuff each gourd with the filling carefully. | Shallow fry stuffed gourds until golden on all sides. | Prepare a light gravy with tomato and spices. | Add stuffed gourds to gravy. | Simmer gently and serve.

ingredients: small baby potatoes, mustard oil, panch phoron, dry red chilli, tomato, ginger, turmeric, coriander powder, salt
method: Prick small baby potatoes all over and fry until golden. | Make paste by frying onion until dark and blending. | Cook onion paste with ginger and spices. | Add beaten yogurt and cook until oil separates. | Add fried potatoes and mix. | Add water and cook until potatoes absorb the masala. | Finish with garam masala and coriander.

ingredients: chana dal, coconut, ghee, dry red chilli, cumin, ginger, bay leaf, garam masala, salt
method: Cook soaked chana dal until tender. | Temper ghee with cumin, bay leaf and red chilli. | Add ginger and coconut pieces. | Mix into dal. | Add garam masala and serve.

ingredients: besan, onion, garlic, mustard seeds, turmeric, red chilli, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add finely chopped green chilli and garlic. | Add chopped onion and cook until soft. | Slowly add besan while stirring to avoid lumps. | Add water gradually to adjust consistency. | Add turmeric and salt. | Cook on low flame until besan is cooked through.

ingredients: flattened rice, onion, mustard seeds, green chilli, turmeric, curry leaves, lemon juice, coriander, oil, salt
method: Wash poha and drain, keeping it moist. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add sliced onion and green chilli. | Cook until onion is translucent. | Add turmeric and salt and mix. | Add soaked poha and toss gently. | Squeeze lemon, garnish with coriander and serve.

ingredients: rice flour, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, ghee, salt, water
method: Prepare dough with rice flour and hot water and knead smooth. | Make filling with fresh coconut, jaggery and cardamom cooked until thick. | Take small dough portions and flatten into cups. | Fill with coconut mixture generously. | Pleat and gather the edges to form a peak. | Steam for 10-12 minutes. | Serve warm with a drizzle of ghee.

ingredients: toor dal, coconut, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, ghee, turmeric, salt
method: Pressure cook toor dal until soft. | Blend with coconut, green chilli and ginger. | Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in ghee. | Add dal mixture and simmer. | Adjust consistency and serve with rice.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, raw banana, yam, coconut, tamarind, red chilli, turmeric, jaggery, oil, salt
method: Cut mixed vegetables into chunks. | Soak tamarind and extract pulp. | Make fresh coconut paste with spices and chilli. | Cook vegetables in tamarind water until tender. | Add coconut paste and mix. | Season with salt and jaggery for balance. | Simmer until gravy thickens and serve.

ingredients: kokum, coconut milk, green chilli, garlic, ginger, coriander, salt
method: Soak kokum in water until pink. | Extract coconut milk. | Mix kokum water into coconut milk. | Add crushed garlic, green chilli and salt. | Stir and serve chilled as digestive drink.

ingredients: moong dal, ginger, green chilli, onion, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Soak and grind moong dal coarsely. | Mix with ginger, green chilli and onion. | Add curry leaves and salt. | Shape into vadas and deep fry. | Serve hot with coconut chutney.

ingredients: small brinjal, onion, peanuts, sesame seeds, coconut, tamarind, red chilli, coriander, oil, salt
method: Grind peanuts, sesame, coconut and spices into masala. | Slit brinjals and stuff with masala. | Heat oil and fry onion. | Add stuffed brinjals and cook covered. | Add tamarind water and simmer. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: yellow cucumber (dosakaya), toor dal, tomato, green chilli, turmeric, tamarind, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Pressure cook dal with dosakaya and tomato. | Add tamarind, turmeric and salt. | Mash slightly and simmer. | Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: maida, chana dal, jaggery, cardamom, turmeric, ghee, oil
method: Make soft dough with maida and rest for an hour. | Cook chana dal with jaggery until thick for filling. | Add cardamom and coconut to the filling. | Stuff dough with filling and flatten carefully. | Roll gently into flat rotis. | Cook on tawa with generous ghee. | Serve warm.

ingredients: rice flour, sesame seeds, ajwain, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour with sesame, ajwain and salt. | Knead into stiff dough. | Press through mould into pretzel shapes. | Deep fry until crisp. | Cool and store.

ingredients: broken rice, onion, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Dry roast broken rice lightly. | Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves. | Add onion and green chilli. | Add broken rice and water. | Cook covered until done. | Serve hot.

ingredients: rice flour, chana dal, sesame seeds, peanuts, green chilli, ginger, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Soak chana dal briefly. | Mix rice flour with dal, sesame, peanuts and spices. | Add water to form soft dough. | Pat thin on greased tawa. | Cook on medium heat until crisp on both sides.

ingredients: grated corn, milk, mustard seeds, green chilli, ginger, turmeric, coconut, lemon, coriander, oil, salt
method: Grate fresh corn on the cob. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add grated ginger and green chilli. | Add grated corn and stir well. | Add turmeric, salt and a little sugar. | Add milk and cook until corn absorbs it. | Garnish with coconut and coriander and serve.

ingredients: wheat flour, ghee, semolina, dal, onion, tomato, garlic, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Make wheat dough balls, boil then bake. | Dip in ghee. | Prepare tadka dal with spices. | Serve bafla dipped in ghee alongside hot dal.

ingredients: khoya, maida, dry fruits, sugar syrup, cardamom, ghee, oil
method: Mix khoya with maida, cardamom and dry fruits. | Knead into a soft dough. | Shape into small round balls or patties. | Deep fry on medium heat until golden brown. | Prepare thin sugar syrup. | Soak fried mawa bati in warm syrup. | Serve garnished with pistachio.

ingredients: wheat flour dumplings, yogurt, besan, turmeric, red chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Make dough with wheat flour and roll thin. | Cut into diamond shapes or strips. | Boil in water until cooked. | Prepare a yogurt-based gravy with spices. | Add cooked wheat dumplings to the gravy. | Simmer until they absorb the flavors. | Serve hot with rice or roti.

ingredients: rice flour, chana dal, ginger, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour with salt and knead with hot water. | Shape into small cylindrical dumplings. | Steam for 10-15 minutes until cooked. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Pour tempering over steamed faras. | Serve with chutney. | Can also be pan-fried after steaming for a crispy version.

ingredients: rice flour, moong dal, green chilli, ginger, onion, coriander, oil, salt
method: Soak rice overnight and grind to a smooth batter. | Add salt and a little water for consistency. | Heat a tawa and grease with oil. | Pour a ladleful of batter and spread thin. | Cook on medium flame until edges lift. | Flip and cook briefly on other side. | Serve with chutney or vegetable curry.

ingredients: besan, yogurt, onion, green chilli, cumin, mustard seeds, turmeric, fenugreek, oil, salt
method: Make smooth batter with besan and yogurt. | Prepare small pakoras and deep fry. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and saute until golden. | Add besan-yogurt mixture and stir continuously. | Add water and bring to a gentle boil. | Add pakoras and simmer for 10 minutes.

ingredients: bottle gourd, wheat flour, besan, methi leaves, turmeric, sesame seeds, oil, sugar, salt
method: Grate bottle gourd and squeeze out water. | Mix with wheat flour, besan, ginger, green chilli and spices. | Knead into a soft dough. | Shape into cylindrical rolls. | Steam for 20 minutes until firm. | Cut into slices and shallow fry until golden. | Pour tempering and serve.

ingredients: pav, spiced potato filling, raw mango chutney, tamarind chutney, pomegranate, sev, peanuts, onion
method: Prepare spiced potato filling with dabeli masala. | Slit pav and spread both chutneys. | Fill with potato mixture. | Top with peanuts, pomegranate and sev. | Grill on tawa. | Serve hot.

ingredients: besan, turmeric, ajwain, black pepper, papad khar, oil, salt
method: Mix besan with turmeric, carom seeds and oil. | Knead into a stiff smooth dough. | Take portions and roll very thin with a rolling pin. | Cut into long strips. | Deep fry in hot oil until crispy and golden. | Drain well on paper towels. | Serve with papaya chutney and jalebi.

ingredients: maida, fresh tuvar lilva, coconut, sesame, ginger, green chilli, lemon, sugar, oil, salt
method: Shell fresh tuvar lilva and cook until soft. | Mash with spices, ginger, green chilli and lemon juice. | Make dough with maida and oil and rest. | Stuff dough with lilva filling and seal. | Roll gently into kachoris. | Deep fry until golden and crispy. | Serve with chutney.

ingredients: whole wheat flour, ghee, jaggery, almonds, cardamom, fennel seeds, dry coconut
method: Roast wheat flour in generous ghee until golden. | Cool and mix with melted jaggery. | Add cardamom, almonds and fennel. | Shape into round balls while warm. | Cool and store.

ingredients: maida, potato, onion, coriander, green chilli, butter, ajwain, pomegranate seeds, salt
method: Make dough with maida, yogurt, oil and baking powder. | Rest the dough for 2 hours. | Make filling with mashed potato, paneer and spices. | Stuff dough balls with filling and roll flat. | Sprinkle nigella seeds and coriander on top. | Cook in a very hot tandoor or oven or tawa with butter. | Serve with chole and raw onion.

ingredients: buttermilk, besan, onion, tomato, fenugreek seeds, red chilli, turmeric, ghee, salt
method: Make batter with besan and buttermilk. | Add turmeric, salt and chilli powder. | Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. | Add onion and saute until golden. | Add the besan-buttermilk mixture and stir. | Bring to a boil stirring continuously. | Simmer for 15 minutes and add garam masala.

ingredients: dried moth bean pods (sangri), dried ker berries, yogurt, red chilli, coriander powder, oil, salt
method: Soak dried sangri in water overnight to rehydrate. | Boil briefly and drain excess water. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds and dry red chilli. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add tomato and spices. | Add soaked sangri and mix. | Cook with a little water until flavors meld.

ingredients: bajra (pearl millet), moong dal, ghee, cumin, turmeric, ginger, salt
method: Soak bajra and moong dal for a few hours. | Pressure cook together until very soft. | Heat ghee and add cumin seeds. | Add onion and cook until soft. | Add ginger and green chilli. | Add the cooked bajra and dal mixture. | Season with salt and serve with ghee and pickle.

ingredients: rajma, chana dal, moong dal, rice, yogurt, cardamom, cloves, ghee, asafoetida, salt
method: Cook rajma until very soft. | Prepare dal with moong and chana dal. | Make a yogurt-based gravy with whole spices. | Cook boor badi if available. | Combine all components in a specific order. | Serve on leaf plates in traditional style. | Each component is separate yet part of the meal.

ingredients: raw banana, yogurt, besan, ginger, garlic, red chilli, cardamom, cloves, ghee, salt
method: Marinate raw banana pieces in yogurt and spices. | Heat ghee and fry whole spices. | Add onion paste and cook until golden. | Add the marinated banana and mix. | Cook until banana is tender and masala is absorbed. | Add cream and finish with cardamom. | Serve with rice or roti.

ingredients: wheat flour, walnuts, poppy seeds, yeast, ghee, salt
method: Mix wheat flour with yeast and warm water. | Knead into a soft dough and allow to rise for 2-3 hours. | Make filling of poppy seeds and walnuts with honey. | Stuff risen dough with filling and shape. | Steam the stuffed bread for 20 minutes. | Serve warm with ghee and dal. | A traditional Himachali bread.

ingredients: buckwheat flour, sugar, ghee, cardamom, milk
method: Mix buckwheat flour with sugar, cardamom and milk. | Make smooth batter. | Cook thin pancakes on greased tawa. | Drizzle ghee and serve warm. | Traditional festival sweet.

ingredients: potato, mint, coriander, green chilli, ginger, lemon, cumin, oil, salt
method: Boil and cube potatoes. | Grind mint, coriander and green chilli into chutney. | Heat oil and add cumin. | Add potatoes and chutney paste. | Toss well and cook for 5 minutes. | Serve with puri.

ingredients: wheat flour, ghee, toor dal, jaggery, cardamom, garlic, tomato, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Make stiff wheat dough and shape into balls. | Bake in oven or over charcoal until golden. | Dip hot baati generously in ghee. | Make panchmel dal with 5 lentils and spices. | Make churma by coarsely grinding roasted wheat balls. | Mix churma with jaggery, ghee and cardamom. | Serve all three together as a complete meal.

ingredients: paneer, cream, milk, cardamom, saffron, fennel, sugar, ghee, cashews
method: Marinate paneer in milk, cream and cardamom. | Heat ghee and fry paneer briefly. | Make a white gravy with onion paste, cream and cashews. | Cook the gravy until fragrant. | Add saffron milk and whole spices. | Add paneer and mix gently. | Simmer until gravy coats the paneer.

ingredients: roasted papad, yogurt, besan, cumin, red chilli, turmeric, coriander, ghee, salt
method: Roast or fry papad and break into pieces. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds. | Add onion, tomato, green chilli and ginger. | Cook until masala is done. | Add yogurt and cook stirring well. | Add water to make a light gravy. | Add papad pieces just before serving.

ingredients: coarse besan, ghee, sugar, cardamom, milk, saffron, almonds, pistachios
method: Coarsely grind besan if available or use ready gram flour. | Roast besan in ghee on very low flame until golden and fragrant. | This takes about 30-40 minutes of constant stirring. | Add sugar syrup of two-thread consistency. | Add cardamom and mix quickly. | Pour into greased tray and spread. | Decorate and cut into squares when set.

ingredients: cashews, onion, tomato, cream, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, kasuri methi, oil, salt
method: Soak cashews in water for 30 minutes. | Fry cashews in ghee until lightly golden. | Make gravy with onion, tomato and cashew paste. | Heat oil and cook the paste until oil separates. | Add cream and whole spices. | Add fried cashews and simmer briefly. | Garnish with cream and coriander.

ingredients: paneer, potato, cream, onion, tomato, cashews, garam masala, kasuri methi, oil, salt
method: Mix paneer and potato, shape into koftas and fry. | Prepare rich onion-tomato-cashew gravy. | Add cream and kasuri methi. | Add koftas to gravy. | Simmer gently and serve hot.

ingredients: toor dal, garlic, red chilli, ghee, turmeric, cumin, tomato, coriander, salt
method: Cook toor dal until soft. | Peel and roughly crush a generous amount of garlic. | Heat ghee until very hot and fry garlic until golden and crispy. | Add dry red chilli and cumin seeds. | Pour the garlic tempering over cooked dal. | Add lemon juice and mix. | Serve garnished with coriander.

ingredients: Indian gooseberry, sugar, saffron, cardamom, cloves
method: Prick amla all over and soak overnight. | Prepare thick sugar syrup. | Cook amla in syrup until translucent. | Add saffron, cardamom and cloves. | Cool and store in jars.

ingredients: sesame seeds, jaggery, ghee
method: Dry roast sesame seeds until golden. | Heat jaggery with very little water to hard crack stage. | Test in cold water for brittleness. | Add sesame seeds immediately and mix off heat. | Roll out thin with greased rolling pin on greased surface. | Cut into strips while still warm. | Cool completely until very hard and crispy.

ingredients: red pumpkin, sugar, ghee, cardamom, milk, cashews, saffron
method: Peel and grate red pumpkin. | Heat ghee and add the grated pumpkin. | Cook on medium flame stirring often until moisture evaporates. | Add sugar and mix until dissolved. | Add cardamom powder and saffron. | Cook until halwa comes together and leaves the pan. | Garnish with dry fruits and serve warm.

ingredients: white bread, milk, sugar, cream, saffron, cardamom, rose water, almonds, pistachios, ghee
method: Fry bread slices in ghee until golden and crispy. | Prepare rabri by reducing milk with sugar and cardamom. | Make sugar syrup and dip fried bread briefly. | Arrange bread on a serving plate. | Pour warm rabri generously over bread. | Garnish with silver foil, pistachio and saffron. | Chill or serve warm.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, onion, ginger-garlic paste, nihari masala, wheat flour, ghee, lemon, coriander, salt
method: Soak mixed vegetables and prepare nihari spice blend. | Heat oil and add whole spices. | Add onion paste and cook until dark golden. | Add the nihari masala and cook well. | Add vegetables and mix. | Add water and simmer on very low heat for a long time. | Finish with ginger juliennes and serve with kulcha.

ingredients: urad dal, rice flour, saffron, food colour, sugar syrup, cardamom, ghee
method: Soak urad dal and grind to a very smooth thick batter. | Add colour if desired and rest for 30 minutes. | Heat oil or ghee in a wide pan. | Pour batter through a cloth with a small hole in a spiral flower pattern. | Fry until crispy and golden. | Dip in warm sugar syrup for a few minutes. | Serve warm.

ingredients: maida, khoya, dry fruits, coconut, sugar, cardamom, ghee
method: Make pastry dough with maida and ghee and rest. | Prepare khoya filling with sugar, dry fruits and cardamom. | Fill and shape gujiya as usual pleating edges. | Brush with milk or egg wash. | Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 20-25 minutes. | Turn once halfway for even browning. | Cool before serving.

ingredients: milk, thandai powder, sugar, saffron, cardamom, almonds, pistachios, rose water
method: Prepare thandai by blending soaked nuts and spices with milk. | Strain the thandai mix. | Boil full fat milk and reduce. | Add thandai mixture and sugar. | Add cardamom and saffron. | Pour into kulfi moulds and freeze overnight. | Unmould by dipping in warm water and serve.

ingredients: betel leaf, coconut, condensed milk, cardamom, gulkand, fennel seeds, sugar
method: Blend betel leaves to a paste. | Mix with desiccated coconut, condensed milk and cardamom. | Add gulkand and mix well. | Cook briefly until mixture thickens. | Cool slightly and shape into round balls. | Roll in desiccated coconut. | Refrigerate until firm before serving.

ingredients: tomato, garlic, green chilli, mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Temper mustard, cumin and curry leaves in oil. | Add garlic and green chilli. | Add chopped tomatoes and cook until mushy. | Mash lightly. | Season and serve with rice or roti.

ingredients: kohlrabi (ganth gobi), onion, tomato, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, oil, salt
method: Peel kohlrabi and cut into cubes. | Heat oil and add cumin seeds. | Add onion and cook until golden. | Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato. | Cook spices well until oil separates. | Add kohlrabi cubes and mix. | Add water and simmer until kohlrabi is tender.

ingredients: radish, walnuts, yogurt, green chilli, ginger, coriander, salt
method: Grate radish and squeeze excess water. | Mix with walnut pieces. | Add yogurt, ginger and green chilli. | Toss with coriander. | Season and serve as chutney.

ingredients: paneer, turmeric, fennel powder, dry ginger, yogurt, ghee, milk, salt
method: Cut paneer into thick rectangles. | Prepare a yogurt-based gravy with fennel powder and dry ginger. | Heat mustard oil and add whole spices. | Add the yogurt-spice mixture and cook gently. | Add turmeric and Kashmiri chilli powder. | Add paneer pieces and simmer carefully. | Do not boil vigorously to prevent yogurt from splitting.

ingredients: roasted brinjal, roasted tomato, roasted potato, mustard oil, green chilli, garlic, onion, coriander, salt
method: Roast brinjal, tomato and potato directly on flame. | Peel and mash together. | Add raw mustard oil, garlic and green chilli. | Mix with chopped onion and coriander. | Season and serve with litti.

ingredients: rice flour, jaggery, poppy seeds, ghee
method: Soak rice overnight and drain. | Grind rice to a fine paste and mix with jaggery. | Add poppy seeds and cardamom powder. | Knead into a soft dough and rest for 3 days. | Shape into flat discs pressing in sesame seeds. | Deep fry on low heat until golden. | Cool and store.

ingredients: rice flour, chana dal, jaggery, cardamom, coconut
method: Cook chana dal with jaggery, coconut and cardamom. | Prepare rice flour dough. | Stuff with filling and shape into dumplings. | Steam until cooked through. | Serve warm as traditional pitha.

ingredients: fermented rice, herbs, water
method: Soak rice for a few days to begin fermentation. | Mix with herbal ingredients and a fermentation starter. | Transfer to a sealed pot and allow to ferment for 5-7 days. | Strain the fermented liquid. | The resulting drink is mildly alcoholic. | Serve at room temperature. | A traditional tribal beverage of Jharkhand.

ingredients: rugra mushrooms, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, turmeric, cumin, coriander, oil, salt
method: Clean and halve rugra mushrooms. | SautÃ© onion, ginger and garlic. | Add tomatoes and spices. | Add mushrooms and cook. | Add water and simmer until gravy thickens. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: cooked rice, water, yogurt, cucumber, lemon, cumin, salt, coriander
method: Soak cooked rice in water overnight to ferment. | Add yogurt, lemon and salt. | Serve with grated cucumber and coriander. | Traditional cooling summer meal.

ingredients: rice, urad dal, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, turmeric leaves
method: Soak rice and urad dal separately and grind. | Prepare coconut and jaggery filling with cardamom. | Wash turmeric leaves and pat dry. | Place batter on turmeric leaves and add filling. | Fold leaf over and steam for 20 minutes. | The turmeric imparts color and aroma. | Serve warm.

ingredients: puffed rice, potato curry, onion, mustard oil, green chilli, turmeric, coriander, salt
method: Prepare a spicy vegetable curry with potato and mixed vegetables. | Puff rice by roasting or use readymade muri. | Combine hot curry with puffed rice just before eating. | The rice softens in the curry. | Add chopped onion and green chilli. | Season with mustard oil and salt. | Serve as a quick snack.

ingredients: baby potato, onion, tomato, yogurt, garam masala, cumin, bay leaf, oil, salt
method: Prick baby potatoes and deep fry until golden. | Heat mustard oil and add whole spices and bay leaf. | Add onion paste and cook until dark golden. | Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato puree and cook well. | Add yogurt and spices and stir until oil separates. | Add fried potatoes and mix to coat with masala. | Add water and simmer covered until potatoes are fully cooked.

ingredients: maida, banana, fennel seeds, cardamom, milk, sugar syrup, ghee
method: Mash banana and mix with maida, fennel and milk. | Make thick batter. | Pour rounds in ghee and fry until golden. | Drain and dip in sugar syrup. | Serve warm with rabdi.

ingredients: raw banana flowers, coconut milk, onion, ginger, green chilli, mustard oil, turmeric, salt
method: Clean banana flowers and sautÃ©. | Add ginger, green chilli and turmeric. | Pour coconut milk and simmer. | Season and finish with mustard oil. | Serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: potato, mustard oil, green chilli, onion, salt
method: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender. | Drain and peel. | Mash with mustard oil, green chilli and raw onion. | Season with salt. | Serve warm with rice and dal.

ingredients: red pumpkin, mustard seeds, dry red chilli, panch phoron, turmeric, sugar, oil, salt
method: Peel red pumpkin and cut into cubes. | Heat mustard oil and add panch phoron. | Add dry red chilli and bay leaf. | Add pumpkin cubes and mix. | Add turmeric, salt and a little sugar. | Cook covered until pumpkin is soft. | Serve dry with rice.

ingredients: fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, ghee
method: Grate fresh coconut finely. | Cook coconut with jaggery on low flame until thick. | Add cardamom powder and mix. | Remove from heat when mixture leaves the pan. | Cool slightly until manageable. | Grease palms with ghee and roll into round balls. | Cool completely before serving.

ingredients: ripe mango pulp, sugar, cardamom
method: Peel ripe mangoes and puree the flesh. | Spread thin layers of mango puree on flat trays. | Sun dry for several days turning once. | The layers will dry and thicken. | Stack dried layers when completely dry. | Cut into pieces and store. | Serve as a sweet snack.

ingredients: jackfruit, onion, ginger-garlic paste, yogurt, bay leaf, garam masala, mustard oil, sugar, salt
method: Cut raw jackfruit into pieces and lightly fry. | Heat mustard oil and add whole spices. | Add onion paste and cook until dark brown. | Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato. | Cook until oil separates and masala is dry. | Add jackfruit and cook on high flame tossing well. | Add water gradually and cook until jackfruit is very tender.

ingredients: raw papaya, mustard paste, green chilli, mustard oil, garlic, turmeric, salt
method: Boil raw papaya until soft and mash. | Dry roast mustard seeds and crush. | Mix mashed papaya with mustard, green chilli and garlic. | Add mustard oil and salt and mix well. | Adjust spice level. | Serve at room temperature with rice. | A simple vegetarian version of the traditional bhorta.

ingredients: raw mango, mustard seeds, red chilli powder, fenugreek, turmeric, garlic, sesame oil, salt
method: Wash raw mangoes and dry completely without any moisture. | Cut into pieces keeping skin on. | Mix with mustard powder, red chilli powder, salt and turmeric. | Add fenugreek seeds and mix well. | Add sesame oil and mix. | Store in a glass jar without water. | Ready after 2-3 days of resting.

ingredients: rice flour, sesame seeds, red chilli, cumin, butter, oil, salt
method: Boil water with salt and butter. | Add rice flour and mix. | Knead dough with sesame, chilli and cumin. | Shape into rings. | Deep fry until golden and crisp. | Cool and store.
