ingredients: rice flour, jaggery, sesame seeds, cardamom, ghee
method: Soak rice and grind to a smooth paste. | Mix with jaggery and cardamom. | Add sesame seeds and mix. | Heat oil in a deep pan on low flame. | Pour thick rounds of batter into oil. | Fry slowly until deep golden brown. | Drain and cool completely.

ingredients: roasted chana, coconut, jaggery, cardamom, ghee, sesame
method: Dry roast chana dal until golden. | Cool and grind to a fine flour. | Mix with jaggery powder and cardamom. | Add ghee and mix until it binds together. | Shape into round ladoos pressing firmly. | If mixture is too dry add a little more ghee. | Store in an airtight container.

ingredients: curry leaves, tamarind, red chilli, urad dal, chana dal, garlic, oil, salt
method: Dry roast dals and curry leaves. | Blend with tamarind, red chilli and garlic. | Temper with oil and mustard. | Serve with idli, dosa or rice.

ingredients: buttermilk, ginger, green chilli, curry leaves, coriander, asafoetida, salt
method: Whisk buttermilk with water. | Add finely chopped ginger, green chilli and curry leaves. | Season with salt and asafoetida. | Garnish with coriander. | Serve chilled as cooling drink.

ingredients: rice flour, fresh coconut, jaggery, cardamom, salt
method: Make rice flour dough with hot water and salt. | Prepare coconut and jaggery filling. | Shape dough into small cups. | Fill with coconut mixture and seal. | Steam for 10-12 minutes until cooked. | Serve warm with ghee. | A traditional Tamil Vinayaka Chaturthi sweet.

ingredients: raw rice, moong dal, jaggery, ghee, cardamom, cashews, raisins, milk
method: Wash raw rice and cook in water. | Add moong dal and cook together until mushy. | Add jaggery and mix until melted. | Add ghee, cardamom and nutmeg. | Add cashews and raisins fried in ghee. | Mix well and adjust consistency. | Serve warm as a festive sweet.

ingredients: idli batter, coconut, mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilli, oil, salt
method: Make thin batter with idli batter and coconut milk. | Add salt and mix. | Heat paniyaram pan and add oil in each mould. | Pour batter into each mould. | Cook covered on low flame until tops are set. | Flip with a skewer and cook other side. | Serve with coconut chutney.

ingredients: black pepper, toor dal, tamarind, tomato, cumin, garlic, curry leaves, ghee, salt
method: Cook dal water with tamarind and tomato. | Add crushed pepper, cumin and garlic. | Simmer until frothy. | Temper with ghee and curry leaves. | Serve as digestive soup.

ingredients: flattened rice, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, cashews, raisins, ghee
method: Wash flattened rice and dry roast briefly. | Boil milk and add the flattened rice. | Cook on low flame until rice is soft. | Add sugar and stir until dissolved. | Add cardamom powder and saffron. | Simmer until payasam is creamy and thick. | Garnish with cashews fried in ghee.

ingredients: taro root (chembu), coconut, green chilli, turmeric, mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chilli, oil, salt
method: Boil taro root until tender. | Grind coconut with green chilli and turmeric. | Add coconut paste to taro and simmer. | Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and red chilli. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: raw banana, yam, coconut, yogurt, green chilli, turmeric, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Boil raw banana or yam until tender. | Grind coconut with cumin and green chilli to a paste. | Mix yogurt with coconut paste. | Add cooked vegetables to yogurt mixture. | Cook on low flame without boiling. | Season with salt and turmeric. | Prepare mustard tempering and pour over.

ingredients: cucumber, coconut, yogurt, green chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Peel and grate cucumber. | Grind coconut with green chilli and cumin. | Mix coconut paste into yogurt. | Add grated cucumber and salt. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil. | Pour tempering over the raita. | Serve chilled as part of an Onam sadya.

ingredients: finger millet flour, milk, jaggery, cardamom, water
method: Soak finger millet flour in water for 30 minutes. | Cook on low flame stirring continuously until thick. | Add milk and stir. | Sweeten with jaggery or sugar. | Add cardamom and mix. | Cool or serve warm. | A nutritious breakfast drink.

ingredients: rice flour, peanuts, sesame seeds, cumin, red chilli, curry leaves, butter, oil, salt
method: Mix rice flour with besan, sesame seeds and spices. | Add chilli powder, asafoetida and salt. | Add oil and water to make a stiff dough. | Roll thin and cut into rounds. | Deep fry in hot oil until crispy. | Drain and cool completely. | Store in airtight container.

ingredients: ash gourd, sugar, ghee, cardamom, cashews, saffron, food colour
method: Peel ash gourd and grate or cube finely. | Cook in a little water until soft. | Drain and mash lightly. | Cook in ghee stirring continuously. | Add sugar and mix until dissolved. | Add cardamom powder and coconut. | Cook until halwa thickens and serve.

ingredients: raw mango, coconut, jaggery, red chilli, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
method: Mix raw mango pieces with mustard powder and chilli. | Add coconut paste, jaggery and tamarind. | Cook in a pan until mango softens. | Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil. | Pour tempering and mix. | The dish should be sweet, sour and spicy. | Serve with rice.

ingredients: toor dal, chana dal, dill leaves, green chilli, ginger, coconut, oil, salt
method: Soak dals and grind coarsely. | Mix with dill, green chilli and coconut. | Shape into cylinders. | Steam until cooked. | Serve with coconut chutney.

ingredients: black sesame seeds, ginger, onion, oil, salt
method: Dry roast black sesame seeds until fragrant. | Grind with ginger, garlic and onion to a coarse paste. | Heat oil and cook the paste until fragrant. | Add green chillies and salt. | Cook on low flame until oil separates. | The chutney should be dark and aromatic. | Serve with rice as a condiment.

ingredients: fermented soybean, onion, ginger, garlic, green chilli, oil, salt
method: SautÃ© onion, ginger and garlic in oil. | Add fermented soybean and green chilli. | Cook until fragrant. | Add water and simmer. | Serve with rice as traditional side dish.

ingredients: red rice, mushrooms, onion, ginger, turmeric, bay leaf, black pepper, oil, salt
method: Wash red rice and cook until done. | Prepare a vegetable or mushroom curry with local spices. | Heat oil and cook onion, ginger and garlic. | Add turmeric and chilli powder. | Add vegetables and cook until done. | Mix cooked rice with the curry. | Serve as a complete one-pot meal.

ingredients: yam, bamboo shoot, dried fish flakes (skip for veg), onion, ginger, oil, salt
method: Peel and cut yam into cubes. | Boil in salted water until tender. | Heat oil and add garlic and onion. | Add green chilli and ginger. | Add boiled yam and toss. | Season with salt and local spices. | Serve as a simple side dish.

ingredients: fermented soybean (axone), tomato, green chilli, ginger, garlic, oil, salt
method: Grind fermented soybean with dried red chillies and garlic. | Heat oil and saute onion until golden. | Add the ground paste and cook on low flame. | Add salt and green chilli. | Cook until fragrant and oil separates. | Adjust consistency with a little water. | Serve as a condiment with rice.

ingredients: millet flour, water, salt
method: Bring water to a boil in a pot. | Slowly add millet flour while stirring. | Stir vigorously and continuously to prevent lumps. | Cook on low flame for 20-30 minutes. | The porridge should be thick and smooth. | Season with salt. | Serve with vegetable stew or chutney.

ingredients: tender bamboo shoot, mustard oil, green chilli, ginger, garlic, turmeric, salt
method: Slice tender bamboo shoots thinly. | Boil to remove bitterness. | Mix with mustard oil and spices. | Add ginger, garlic and chilli. | Store in jar and use after 2 days.
